generic.Defined scope/population: All documents in today's intake batches in OpenText that require a retention classification before release.
generic.In-scope period: Current intake day, from batch open at the scan station to batch release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention class, retention start date equal to receipt date, and override reason code where manual.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Classified document count equals the batch item count recorded on the intake log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Document profile holds classifier id, classification timestamp and mapping table version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped document types sit in the records-management exception queue with a recorded disposition.
generic.Test population: Every document logged in the DMS during the current intake day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero documents released with a null retention class or a null retention start date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped types route to the records-management queue and are never defaulted to Permanent.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Class matches the document-type-to-retention mapping and legal hold is inherited where active.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText document profile metadata plus the daily intake exception queue report.

steps.title: Extract the unclassified intake batch list from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Open the intake batch queue in OpenText and filter to batches at status Scanned but not yet Released.
List document id and document type for every item in those batches.
Confirm each item already carries a document type before classification begins.
Done when the day's unclassified document list is extracted.
verify: Compare the extracted item count against the intake log count for the same day.
Pass when the extracted list count equals the intake log item count.

steps.title: Derive the retention class from the mapping table in the DMS
sop: Run the document-type-to-retention mapping so each item defaults to Permanent, Limited or Destroy-after-processing.
Confirm the mapping table version in force is the current approved version.
Leave items with no mapped type unclassified rather than assigning a default.
Done when every mapped document carries a system-derived retention class.
verify: Sample ten classified items and re-derive the class from the mapping table by hand.
Pass when every sampled class matches the mapping table output.

steps.title: Set the retention start date to receipt date on the document profile
sop: Read the receipt date from the DMS intake log entry, not the scan timestamp.
Write that date into the retention start date field on the document profile.
Correct any item where the scan date was defaulted in error.
Done when every document carries a retention start date equal to its receipt date.
verify: Query documents where retention start date does not equal the logged receipt date.
Pass when that query returns no rows for the day.

steps.title: Record a reason code for every manual retention override in OpenText
sop: List documents where the retention class differs from the mapping table default.
Capture the override reason code on the document profile for each one.
Reject any override submitted without a reason code and return it to the clerk.
Done when every override carries a reason code.
verify: Run the override report and check the reason code column for blanks.
Pass when no override row has a blank reason code.

steps.title: Inherit the legal-hold flag from the parent policy or claim record
sop: Check the hold register for an active hold on each indexed policy or claim number.
Set the legal-hold flag on the document profile where a parent hold is active.
Suppress auto-disposition on those documents regardless of retention class.
Done when all documents under a held parent carry the hold flag.
verify: Cross-check today's documents against the open hold register by policy or claim number.
Pass when every document under an active hold is flagged.

steps.title: Route unmapped documents to the records-management exception queue
sop: Select documents still carrying no retention class after the mapping run.
Move them to the records-management exception queue in the DMS with the unmapped reason.
Raise a mapping table change request for any recurring unmapped document type.
Done when no unclassified document remains in the release path.
verify: Check the release-ready batch list for any item with a null retention class.
Pass when the release-ready list contains no unclassified item.

steps.title: Release the batch in OpenText once every document carries a class
sop: Re-run the null-class check across the batch immediately before release.
Move the batch to Released status and stamp the classifier id and timestamp.
Record the mapping table version used against the batch record.
Done when the batch is Released with a complete classification stamp.
verify: Open the released batch record and confirm class, start date and stamp are present.
Pass when every released document shows a class, a start date and a release stamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: All scanned image batches awaiting QA in OpenText before they move to Released status.
generic.In-scope period: Current scanning shift, from image commit to batch release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Batch id, physical page count, image page count, reviewer id and defect reason where failed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Image page count matches the physical page count on the batch header sheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: QA pass stamp on the batch carries reviewer id and review timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed batches sit in the rescan queue with a defect reason and rescan outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: Every scanned batch presented for QA during the shift.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero batches at Released status with an open rescan defect.
generic.Exception handling path: Skew, cut-off, illegible or misfeed defects route the whole document to rescan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pages legible at 200-300 dpi, correctly oriented, complete and free of suppressed non-blank pages.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText batch QA record and the rescan queue defect log.

steps.title: Reconcile image page count to the batch header sheet in OpenText
sop: Open the scanned batch in OpenText and read the committed image page count.
Compare it against the physical page count written on the batch header sheet.
Investigate any variance at the scanner before reviewing image quality.
Done when image and physical page counts agree or the variance is explained.
verify: Re-read both counts on the batch record after any rescan.
Pass when image page count equals the header sheet page count.

steps.title: Correct orientation and skew on every page in the DMS viewer
sop: Page through the batch in the OpenText viewer looking for upside-down or 90-degree pages.
Rotate and de-skew affected pages before the batch is released.
Rescan pages where rotation cannot recover a readable image.
Done when every page in the batch is right-side-up and de-skewed.
verify: Re-open the batch and spot-check the first and last page of each document.
Pass when no page is misoriented or visibly skewed.

steps.title: Spot-check legibility of signatures, dates and policy numbers in OpenText
sop: Zoom to the signature block, date field and policy number on a sample of pages.
Confirm handwritten content is readable at the standard 200-300 dpi capture setting.
Fail the batch where any key field on the sample is unreadable.
Done when the legibility sample has been reviewed and recorded.
verify: Re-read the sampled fields against the physical original where still available.
Pass when every sampled key field is legible on the image.

steps.title: Review blank-page and double-feed detection output in the DMS
sop: Open the scanner detection report for suppressed blanks and suspected double feeds.
Open each suppressed page and confirm it is genuinely blank.
Rescan any document where a double feed dropped content.
Done when every suppressed or flagged page has been reviewed.
verify: Count reviewed detections against the detections listed on the scanner report.
Pass when every flagged detection carries a review outcome.

steps.title: Route failed batches to the rescan queue with a defect reason
sop: Select the defect reason from skew, cut-off, illegible or misfeed on the batch record.
Move the failed batch to the rescan queue in OpenText.
Rescan the affected document in full rather than inserting single pages.
Done when every failed batch is in the rescan queue with a defect reason.
verify: Check the rescan queue for entries with a blank defect reason.
Pass when every rescan entry carries a defect reason.

steps.title: Stamp the QA pass and release the batch in OpenText
sop: Confirm no open rescan defect remains against the batch.
Apply the QA pass stamp capturing reviewer id and timestamp.
Move the batch status to Released only after the stamp is applied.
Done when the batch is Released with a QA pass stamp.
verify: Query Released batches for a missing QA stamp or an open defect.
Pass when no Released batch has a missing stamp or an open defect.

generic.Defined scope/population: All physical mail received at the intake desk today and prepped into scan batches.
generic.In-scope period: Current mail day, from mail open to batch hand-off at the scan station.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Batch id, item count, mail-received date and preparer initials on every batch header sheet.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Batch header item count equals the physical documents counted at sort.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Batch record in the DMS carries preparer initials and the mail-received date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cheques and negotiable items are logged to the cashiering log with routing noted.
generic.Test population: Every batch created at the intake desk during the mail day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero batches missing an item count or a mail-received date.
generic.Exception handling path: Oversize, stapled or damaged items are prepped separately before the batch moves on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batches sorted by business unit, product line and document type with barcode separators inserted.
generic.Evidence location: DMS batch record plus the physical batch header sheet in the scan station tray.

steps.title: Open and sort mail by business unit, product line and document type
sop: Open date-stamped mail at the intake desk and sort into business unit and product line piles.
Sub-sort each pile by document type using the intake sorting guide.
Set aside anything that cannot be sorted for the unclassified research pile.
Done when all mail for the day is sorted into typed piles.
verify: Spot-check three piles against the sorting guide definitions.
Pass when sampled items sit in the correct business unit and type pile.

steps.title: Pull cheques and negotiable items into the cashiering log
sop: Remove cheques, cash and other negotiable instruments from every sorted pile.
Record each item in the cashiering log with amount, payer and policy reference.
Route the items to cashiering and secure them before batching continues.
Done when no negotiable item remains in the batching stream.
verify: Re-scan the prepped batches for any remaining cheque or negotiable item.
Pass when no negotiable item is found inside a scan batch.

steps.title: Prep oversize, stapled and double-sided items for the scanner
sop: Remove staples and clips and flatten folded or creased pages.
Set double-sided items aside for the duplex scanner profile.
Photocopy oversize or fragile originals that cannot feed safely.
Done when every item in the batch is scanner-ready.
verify: Fan through the prepped batch checking for staples, folds and oversize sheets.
Pass when no unprepped item remains in the batch.

steps.title: Insert document-type barcode separator sheets into each batch
sop: Select the barcode separator matching the document type for each document.
Insert one separator in front of every document in the batch.
Confirm the barcode is clean and unfolded so the scanner can read it.
Done when every document in the batch is preceded by its type separator.
verify: Count separators in the batch against the document count on the header sheet.
Pass when separator count equals document count.

steps.title: Complete the batch header sheet and create the batch in the DMS
sop: Write batch id, item count, mail-received date and preparer initials on the header sheet.
Create the matching batch record in the document management repository.
Key the same item count and mail-received date into the batch record.
Done when the DMS batch record mirrors the header sheet.
verify: Compare the DMS batch record fields to the physical header sheet.
Pass when item count and mail-received date match on both.

steps.title: Register the batch in the workflow tool and hand it to scanning
sop: Create the intake work item for the batch in the workflow/case management tool.
Set the batch status to Ready to Scan and assign it to the scan station queue.
Hand the physical batch and header sheet to the scan station tray.
Done when the batch is queued for scanning in the workflow tool.
verify: List batches created today in the DMS and match to workflow work items.
Pass when every DMS batch has a matching workflow work item.

generic.Defined scope/population: All scanned images awaiting a document type, whether auto-classified or in the manual review queue.
generic.In-scope period: Current intake day, from image commit to routing release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type from the controlled taxonomy and the auto-classification confidence score.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Typed document count equals scanned image count for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Classification event stores classifier, confidence score, taxonomy version and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Below-threshold items sit in the manual review queue with the reviewer decision recorded.
generic.Test population: Every document released from intake during the current day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero released documents with a blank or non-taxonomy document type.
generic.Exception handling path: Unidentifiable correspondence takes the unclassified or research type rather than a best guess.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Type drawn from the controlled taxonomy and multi-document envelopes split before routing.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText classification history and the workflow manual review queue log.

steps.title: Run auto-classification over the committed batch in OpenText
sop: Trigger the classification job over the released scan batch in OpenText.
Confirm the taxonomy version loaded is the current approved version.
Record the job id and completion status against the batch.
Done when the classification job completes over the whole batch.
verify: Compare classified item count to the batch item count on the job log.
Pass when the job processed every item in the batch.

steps.title: Drop below-threshold items into the manual review queue in the workflow tool
sop: Compare each item's confidence score against the published classification threshold.
Route every item under threshold to the manual review queue in the workflow tool.
Leave above-threshold items on their auto-assigned taxonomy type.
Done when all low-confidence items sit in the manual review queue.
verify: Query released items for a confidence score below threshold with no manual review record.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Assign taxonomy document types in the manual review queue
sop: Open each queued image and read enough to identify the document type.
Select the type from the controlled taxonomy list in the DMS profile.
Never key a free-text type where the taxonomy has no match.
Done when every queued item carries a taxonomy type.
verify: Run the released item list and check document type against the taxonomy value list.
Pass when no released type sits outside the taxonomy.

steps.title: Split multi-document envelopes into separate documents in OpenText
sop: Identify images containing more than one distinct document.
Use the OpenText split function to break them into separate documents.
Assign each resulting document its own taxonomy type.
Done when no released image contains two different document types.
verify: Spot-check ten multi-page images for an unsplit second document.
Pass when no sampled image contains an unsplit second document.

steps.title: Assign the unclassified or research type to unidentifiable correspondence
sop: Select items that cannot be matched to any taxonomy type after review.
Assign the unclassified or research type rather than a nearest guess.
Route them to the research queue in the workflow tool for follow-up.
Done when no ambiguous item carries a guessed type.
verify: Review the research queue entries against their images.
Pass when every research item is genuinely unidentifiable rather than mistyped.

steps.title: Process downstream reclassification returns for taxonomy tuning
sop: Pull items returned from downstream teams with a reclassification reason.
Correct the document type in OpenText using the audited reclassify function.
Log recurring misclassification patterns for taxonomy and model tuning.
Done when all returned items are retyped and the reasons are logged.
verify: Check the reclassification log for open returns older than the review cadence.
Pass when no returned item is left unreclassified beyond the cadence.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documents released from intake to destination work queues during the shift.
generic.In-scope period: Current shift, from intake release to end-of-shift routing confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Routing status, destination queue and confirmation timestamp on each document profile.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count released from intake equals count landed across destination work queues.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmation status written back to the document profile with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed hand-offs sit on the routing exception report with the re-drive outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: Every document released from intake in the shift.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No item older than one business day remains in Routing Pending status.
generic.Exception handling path: Interface errors between the DMS and policy admin system are logged for IT with the error text.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Routing status Confirmed with the destination queue recorded on the document.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool routing exception report and the DMS document routing history.

steps.title: Run the end-of-shift routing exception report in the workflow tool
sop: Run the routing exception report for the shift in the workflow/case management tool.
List every document whose hand-off to a destination queue failed.
Note the failure reason recorded against each item.
Done when the exception list for the shift is produced.
verify: Re-run the report after working the list.
Pass when the re-run exception list is empty or every entry carries an action.

steps.title: Re-drive failed hand-offs from the DMS to the destination queue
sop: Select each failed item and re-trigger the routing action from the DMS.
Confirm the item now appears in the intended destination work queue.
Escalate items that fail a second re-drive rather than retrying indefinitely.
Done when every failed hand-off is re-driven or escalated.
verify: Open each re-driven item in the destination queue.
Pass when every re-driven item is visible in its destination queue.

steps.title: Reconcile intake released counts to destination queue landed counts
sop: Extract the count released from intake in the DMS for the shift.
Extract the landed count per destination queue from the workflow tool.
Investigate any variance item by item until it is explained.
Done when released and landed counts reconcile or the variance is explained.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation after all re-drives are complete.
Pass when released count equals landed count plus explained exceptions.

steps.title: Flag documents stuck in the routing interface beyond the SLA window
sop: Filter the workflow tool for items in Routing Pending past the SLA window.
Flag each one and assign it manually to the correct destination queue.
Record the manual assignment reason on the document profile.
Done when no item sits pending beyond the SLA window.
verify: Query Routing Pending items older than one business day.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Log DMS to policy admin interface errors for IT follow-up
sop: Capture the raw error text for each interface failure from the workflow error log.
Raise an IT ticket with the error text, document id and timestamp.
Track the ticket until the interface defect is resolved.
Done when every interface error has an open or closed IT ticket.
verify: Match interface error entries to IT ticket references.
Pass when every interface error carries a ticket reference.

steps.title: Write the Confirmed routing status back to the document profile
sop: Set routing status to Confirmed on each successfully landed document in the DMS.
Record the destination queue name against the document profile.
Rely on the Confirmed status to prevent the item being re-routed twice.
Done when every landed document shows status Confirmed.
verify: Query landed documents lacking a Confirmed status or a destination queue.
Pass when no landed document is missing either value.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound items that are time-barred or statutory, including court orders, subpoenas and DOI mail.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day, from mail open to receiving-team acknowledgement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Urgent flag, postmark date, destination team and acknowledgement timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Urgent intake log count equals the count of urgent-flagged items in the workflow tool.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgement timestamp and acknowledging user held against the urgent item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unacknowledged urgent items are escalated to the team lead with the escalation recorded.
generic.Test population: Every item flagged Urgent during the business day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No urgent item remains unacknowledged past the end of the business day.
generic.Exception handling path: Court orders, subpoenas and regulator mail trigger same-day notification to the owning team lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Urgent items show a priority routing indicator and an acknowledgement timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool urgent queue plus the separate urgent intake log in the DMS.

steps.title: Identify time-barred and statutory items at the mail-open step
sop: Scan opened mail for grace-period responses, reinstatements, court orders, subpoenas and DOI letters.
Pull those items out of the general sorting stream immediately.
Use the urgent-item identification guide where the category is unclear.
Done when all urgent-category items are separated from general mail.
verify: Spot-check the general batch for an item matching an urgent category.
Pass when no urgent-category item is found in the general batch.

steps.title: Capture the postmark date for time-barred items in the DMS
sop: Retain and image the envelope for any item where the postmark starts a clock.
Key the postmark date onto the document profile in the DMS.
Link the envelope image to the document record.
Done when every time-barred item carries a postmark date and envelope image.
verify: Query urgent items with a statutory deadline and no postmark date.
Pass when no such item exists.

steps.title: Set the Urgent flag on the document profile in the DMS
sop: Set the Urgent flag on each identified item in the document management repository.
Record the urgency category such as statutory deadline, court order or regulator mail.
Do not release the item into normal batching without the flag set.
Done when every identified item carries an Urgent flag and category.
verify: Compare flagged item count to the urgent items separated at mail open.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Route the flagged items with priority in the workflow tool
sop: Confirm the Urgent flag drives priority routing rather than FIFO placement.
Check each item lands at the top of its destination queue.
Manually reprioritise anything that landed in FIFO order.
Done when every urgent item sits at the top of its destination queue.
verify: Open each destination queue and read the top entries.
Pass when urgent items appear ahead of standard items in every queue.

steps.title: Send same-day notification for court orders, subpoenas and regulator mail
sop: Notify the owning team lead the same day for every court order, subpoena or DOI item.
Include the document id, receipt date, postmark date and destination queue.
Record the notification against the item in the workflow tool.
Done when every legal or regulator item has a same-day notification recorded.
verify: Compare notification records to the list of legal and regulator items received.
Pass when every such item has a notification dated the receipt day.

steps.title: Track urgent items on the urgent intake log until acknowledged
sop: Add each urgent item to the separate urgent intake log in the DMS.
Chase the receiving team for acknowledgement before end of business.
Record the acknowledgement timestamp and acknowledging user on the log.
Done when every urgent item on the log is acknowledged.
verify: Read the urgent intake log at end of day for unacknowledged entries.
Pass when no urgent item is unacknowledged at end of business.

generic.Defined scope/population: All QA-passed scanned images awaiting index values before release from intake.
generic.In-scope period: Current intake day, from QA pass to intake release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy, claim or contract number plus insured name, effective date and document date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indexed document count equals the QA-passed image count for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Index history holds indexer id, timestamp and any audited re-index events.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched documents sit in the unmatched holding folder with research notes recorded.
generic.Test population: Every document indexed and released during the intake day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Primary identifier populated and resolving to a record on 100 percent of released items.
generic.Exception handling path: Numbers failing validation against the policy admin system are rejected rather than saved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Index fields match the indexing standard and the identifier resolves to an existing record.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText index history plus the unmatched holding folder research log.

steps.title: Key the primary identifier into the index screen in OpenText
sop: Open each QA-passed image and read the policy, claim or contract number from the document.
Key the identifier into the primary index field in OpenText.
Do not guess an identifier where the document is ambiguous.
Done when every image carries a keyed primary identifier or is marked unmatched.
verify: Count keyed items against the QA-passed image count.
Pass when every QA-passed image is keyed or marked unmatched.

steps.title: Validate the identifier against the policy admin system before commit
sop: Let the index screen call the policy admin system to resolve the keyed number.
Reject and re-key any identifier that fails to resolve rather than saving it.
Send persistently unresolvable items to the unmatched holding folder.
Done when every committed identifier resolves to an existing record.
verify: Re-run identifier resolution across the day's committed documents.
Pass when every committed identifier resolves to a record.

steps.title: Capture insured name, effective date and document date as index fields
sop: Key insured name, effective date and document date per the indexing standard.
Take values from the document face rather than from the resolved record.
Flag any mismatch between document values and the admin record for research.
Done when all secondary index fields are populated.
verify: Sample fifteen indexed documents against their images.
Pass when every sampled secondary field matches the document face.

steps.title: Apply the double-key verify pass on high-value document types
sop: Identify document types on the high-value list requiring verification.
Have a second operator re-key the primary identifier in OpenText.
Resolve any mismatch by referring back to the document image.
Done when every high-value item has a completed verify pass.
verify: Query high-value documents lacking a verify-pass record.
Pass when no high-value document is missing its verify pass.

steps.title: Work the unmatched holding folder with recorded research notes
sop: Open the unmatched holding folder in OpenText and take the oldest items first.
Search the policy admin system by name, address or effective date to find the record.
Record research notes and the outcome against each item.
Done when every unmatched item is resolved or escalated within the research SLA.
verify: Read the holding folder for items aged beyond the research SLA.
Pass when no item exceeds the research SLA.

steps.title: Correct index errors through the audited re-index function in OpenText
sop: Use the OpenText re-index function to correct any wrong index value.
Never delete and rescan a document to fix an index error.
Confirm the index history captures the before and after values.
Done when every correction is applied through the audited function.
verify: Review the index history for corrections lacking a before-and-after entry.
Pass when every correction carries a complete audit entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every item received across postal mail, fax, secure email, portal upload and courier channels today.
generic.In-scope period: Current mail day, from physical arrival to close of the daily intake log.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt timestamp, source channel, batch id and operator id on every log entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Daily log total equals the mailroom item count before the log is closed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Log entry audit trail shows creation timestamp and any post-commit edit reason.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items lacking a determinable receipt date are logged as exceptions with the basis used.
generic.Test population: All DMS log entries created during the mail day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero log entries missing receipt timestamp, source channel or batch id.
generic.Exception handling path: Post-commit edits require an audit reason recorded on the log entry.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Receipt timestamp reflects physical arrival, with postmark captured where the envelope is retained.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText intake log entries and the daily mailroom reconciliation sheet.

steps.title: Record physical arrival date as the receipt timestamp in the DMS
sop: Read the intake date stamp applied when the item arrived at the desk.
Key that date and time as the receipt timestamp on the DMS log entry.
Never substitute the scan timestamp for the arrival timestamp.
Done when every item has a receipt timestamp equal to its arrival.
verify: Compare log receipt timestamps against the physical date stamps on a sample.
Pass when every sampled timestamp matches the date stamp.

steps.title: Capture the postmark where the envelope is retained
sop: Retain envelopes for items where a statutory deadline runs from the postmark.
Image the envelope and key the postmark date onto the log entry.
Link the envelope image to the document record in OpenText.
Done when every retained envelope has an imaged postmark on the log.
verify: Query statutory items with a retained envelope and no postmark date.
Pass when no such entry exists.

steps.title: Record the source channel on every DMS log entry
sop: Select the channel from postal mail, fax, secure email, portal upload or courier.
Set the channel on the log entry at the time the item is logged.
Correct any channel defaulted incorrectly by the ingestion interface.
Done when every log entry carries a source channel.
verify: Run the day's log filtered on blank source channel.
Pass when the blank-channel filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Store batch id and operator id on the log entry for traceability
sop: Key the physical batch id from the header sheet onto each log entry.
Confirm the logged-in operator id is captured on the entry.
Fix entries where the batch id does not match the physical batch.
Done when every entry traces to a physical batch and an operator.
verify: Pick three batches and trace their log entries back to the header sheets.
Pass when every traced entry resolves to the correct physical batch.

steps.title: Reconcile daily log totals to the mailroom item count
sop: Total the DMS log entries created for the day by channel.
Compare against the mailroom item count recorded at sort.
Investigate and resolve any variance before the log is closed.
Done when log totals and mailroom counts agree.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after adjustments.
Pass when the DMS log total equals the mailroom count.

steps.title: Close the daily intake log and review the audit trail in OpenText
sop: Close the day's intake log in OpenText once reconciliation passes.
Review the audit trail for post-commit edits to receipt timestamps.
Confirm each edit carries an audit reason and challenge any that do not.
Done when the log is closed and all edits carry reasons.
verify: Run the post-commit edit report for the closed log day.
Pass when no edit lacks an audit reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: All intake work in the received, scanned, indexed and routed stages across every channel.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day measured against the daily SLA targets.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Stage counts, hours-in-queue buckets and SLA target values on the intake dashboard.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Stage counts on the dashboard reconcile to DMS and workflow queue counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard snapshot saved with the refresh timestamp for the reporting day.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each SLA miss carries a root cause of volume, staffing, scanner outage or interface failure.
generic.Test population: All intake items in flight on the current day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Same-day scan and next-day index SLAs measured separately against their targets.
generic.Exception handling path: Volume above forecast triggers an overtime or cross-trained staffing request before ageing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dashboard shows actual versus target counts by process stage for the current day.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool intake dashboard plus the saved daily SLA monitoring snapshot.

steps.title: Refresh the intake dashboard stage counts in the workflow tool
sop: Refresh the intake dashboard so received, scanned, indexed and routed counts are current.
Confirm the refresh timestamp is within the monitoring cadence.
Note any stage where the count failed to refresh.
Done when all four stage counts are current on the dashboard.
verify: Compare dashboard stage counts against DMS and workflow queue counts.
Pass when dashboard counts reconcile to the underlying queues.

steps.title: Compare stage counts against the daily SLA targets
sop: Read the published daily SLA target for each intake stage.
Compare the current actual count against target on the dashboard.
Mark any stage tracking behind target for intervention.
Done when every stage carries an actual-versus-target position.
verify: Re-read the target values against the published SLA schedule.
Pass when every stage shows the correct target alongside its actual.

steps.title: Bucket the backlog by hours-in-queue in the workflow tool
sop: Split the open backlog into the 0-4, 4-24 and 24-plus hours-in-queue buckets.
Direct staff to work the 24-plus bucket before newer arrivals.
Recheck the buckets mid-shift to confirm the oldest work is draining.
Done when the aged backlog is bucketed and the oldest bucket is being worked first.
verify: Re-read the 24-plus bucket count at the end of the shift.
Pass when the 24-plus bucket is smaller than at the start of the shift.

steps.title: Measure scan and index SLAs separately on the dashboard
sop: Read the same-day scan SLA attainment on its own metric tile.
Read the next-day index SLA attainment on a separate tile.
Reject any blended intake SLA number as the reported measure.
Done when both SLAs are reported as distinct figures.
verify: Check the dashboard for a single blended intake SLA figure.
Pass when scan and index attainment are shown separately.

steps.title: Raise a staffing request when volume exceeds forecast
sop: Compare received volume against the daily forecast on the dashboard.
Escalate to the operations specialist where volume exceeds the forecast trigger.
Request overtime or cross-trained staff before the backlog ages past four hours.
Done when a staffing request is raised for every forecast breach.
verify: Match forecast breach days to raised staffing requests.
Pass when every forecast breach has a matching request.

steps.title: Record the root cause for every SLA miss on the monitoring log
sop: For each missed SLA select a root cause of volume, staffing, scanner outage or interface failure.
Record the cause and the corrective action on the daily monitoring log.
Carry unresolved causes into the next day's review.
Done when every SLA miss carries a recorded root cause.
verify: Read the monitoring log for misses with a blank root cause.
Pass when no SLA miss lacks a root cause.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documents routed to business-unit queues that require an availability notification.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day, from routing confirmation to notification send.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document id, document type, index identifier, DMS link and recipient on every notification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notification count equals the count of routed documents requiring notification.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification record stored against the document with recipient and send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual email notifications are logged as exceptions with the reason the queue notice failed.
generic.Test population: All notifications sent during the business day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero notifications containing policyholder PII beyond the record identifier.
generic.Exception handling path: Urgent items are notified immediately rather than on the batch notification cycle.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recipients match the current business-unit routing matrix and the notification carries a DMS link.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool notification history and the SharePoint routing matrix version in force.

steps.title: Use the system-generated queue notification in the workflow tool
sop: Confirm the workflow tool queue notification fired on routing confirmation.
Treat the queue notification as the primary mechanism for standard items.
Reserve manual email for items where the queue notification failed.
Done when queue notifications have fired for all routed documents.
verify: Compare routed document count to queue notification count.
Pass when every routed document has a queue notification.

steps.title: Validate recipients against the routing matrix in SharePoint
sop: Open the current business-unit routing matrix held in SharePoint.
Check each notification recipient against the matrix entry for that document type.
Correct recipients that no longer match the matrix before sending.
Done when every recipient is validated against the current matrix.
verify: Sample ten notifications and re-check recipients against the matrix.
Pass when every sampled recipient matches the matrix.

steps.title: Build the notification payload with the DMS link and no document
sop: Include document id, document type, index identifier and the DMS link in the body.
Never attach the document image itself to the notification.
Keep the body free of names, addresses and other policyholder PII.
Done when every notification carries the link and no attached document.
verify: Review the sent notification bodies for attachments or PII.
Pass when no notification contains an attachment or PII beyond the identifier.

steps.title: Notify urgent items immediately outside the batch cycle
sop: Filter the routed list for items carrying the Urgent flag.
Send their notifications on sight rather than waiting for the batch cycle.
Confirm the receiving team acknowledges the urgent notification.
Done when every urgent item is notified immediately.
verify: Compare urgent item routing timestamps to notification timestamps.
Pass when no urgent notification waited for the batch cycle.

steps.title: Send manual email only for exception items and log the reason
sop: Identify documents where the queue notification could not be delivered.
Send a manual email from the shared intake mailbox in Microsoft 365.
Log the exception reason against the document in the workflow tool.
Done when every manual email carries a logged exception reason.
verify: Read the exception log for manual emails with no reason recorded.
Pass when every manual email has a logged reason.

steps.title: Record the notification event against the document profile
sop: Write the notification record against the document in the workflow tool.
Store recipient and send timestamp on the record.
Flag documents with no notification record for follow-up.
Done when every notified document holds a notification record.
verify: Query routed documents lacking a notification record.
Pass when no routed document is missing its notification record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound items across postal mail, secure fax, shared intake mailbox, portal upload and courier.
generic.In-scope period: Current shift, from the first channel sweep to the end-of-shift sweep.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date stamp or system receipt timestamp and channel on every received item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items swept from each channel equal items entered into the intake receipt log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Date stamp on the physical item and system receipt timestamp on the electronic item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Misdirected mail is recorded on the misdirected-mail log with the handling outcome.
generic.Test population: All items received across every channel during the shift.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Intake mailbox, fax queue and portal folder show zero unswept items at end of shift.
generic.Exception handling path: Cheques and negotiable instruments go to the remittance log and secure storage before processing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every received item carries a date stamp or system receipt timestamp before it moves on.
generic.Evidence location: Intake receipt log in the DMS, the Microsoft 365 shared mailbox and the remittance log.

steps.title: Collect postal mail and courier deliveries and date-stamp at the desk
sop: Collect the day's post from the PO box and accept courier deliveries at the desk.
Apply the intake date stamp to each item as it is opened.
Keep the envelope with the item where a postmark may be needed.
Done when all physical items are date-stamped.
verify: Fan through the received pile checking for undated items.
Pass when every physical item carries a date stamp.

steps.title: Sweep the shared intake mailbox in Microsoft 365 to zero
sop: Open the shared intake mailbox in Microsoft 365 on the documented sweep cadence.
Save each attachment into the intake ingestion folder with its receipt timestamp.
File the swept mail item so the inbox returns to zero.
Done when the shared intake mailbox is empty for the sweep.
verify: Open the shared mailbox after the sweep.
Pass when the mailbox shows zero unswept items.

steps.title: Sweep the secure fax queue and portal upload folder
sop: Open the secure fax queue and the portal upload folder on the sweep cadence.
Move every item into the DMS ingestion path preserving the receipt timestamp.
Record the channel against each item as fax or portal upload.
Done when both queues are emptied for the sweep.
verify: Re-open the fax queue and portal folder after the sweep.
Pass when both show zero unswept items.

steps.title: Separate misdirected mail per the misdirected-mail procedure
sop: Identify items for the wrong entity, personal mail and unsolicited marketing.
Handle them per the misdirected-mail procedure instead of scanning them.
Record each item on the misdirected-mail log with its handling outcome.
Done when no misdirected item remains in the scanning stream.
verify: Check the prepped batches for misdirected items.
Pass when no misdirected item is found in a scan batch.

steps.title: Log cheques and negotiable instruments in the remittance log
sop: Pull cheques and negotiable instruments from the received items immediately.
Record each in the remittance log with amount, payer and reference.
Place them in the secure remittance store before any other processing.
Done when every negotiable item is logged and secured.
verify: Reconcile the remittance log entries to the items in the secure store.
Pass when log entries and secured items agree.

steps.title: Secure physical items in the locked intake area pending scanning
sop: Move all date-stamped physical items into the locked intake area.
Confirm the area is locked whenever the intake desk is unattended.
Record the batch location so items can be traced between receipt and scan.
Done when all physical items are stored in the locked intake area.
verify: Walk the intake desk at end of shift for items left out.
Pass when no received item is left outside the locked area.

generic.Defined scope/population: All prior-day intake volumes by channel and document type plus the routing accuracy sample.
generic.In-scope period: Prior business day, reported before the published morning cut-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Received, scanned, indexed and routed volumes, misroute counts and SLA attainment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report volumes reconcile to the DMS intake log and workflow queue counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published report version stored with the run date and the data extract timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every SLA miss carries variance commentary naming cause and corrective action.
generic.Test population: Prior-day intake items and the QA index error sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report issued to operations management before the published cut-off time.
generic.Exception handling path: Misroutes are listed by destination queue and returned to intake for cause analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report contains volume, routing accuracy and SLA attainment sections for the prior day.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool reporting module and the distributed daily intake report.

steps.title: Extract prior-day volumes by channel and document type from the DMS
sop: Run the intake volume extract in the document management repository for the prior day.
Break the counts out by channel and by document type.
Note the extract timestamp for the report footer.
Done when received, scanned, indexed and routed volumes are extracted.
verify: Reconcile extracted totals to the closed daily intake log.
Pass when extracted totals equal the closed log totals.

steps.title: Compute routing accuracy from workflow tool routing outcomes
sop: Pull correctly-routed and total-routed counts from the workflow tool.
Compute accuracy as correctly-routed divided by total routed.
List misroutes by destination queue underneath the headline figure.
Done when routing accuracy and the misroute breakdown are computed.
verify: Recompute the ratio from the raw counts on the extract.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Take the index error rate from the QA sample not a manual tally
sop: Pull the index QA sample results for the prior day from the DMS.
Compute the index error rate from the sample outcomes.
Reject any manually tallied error figure as the reported number.
Done when the index error rate comes from the QA sample.
verify: Trace the reported error rate back to the QA sample records.
Pass when the reported rate is reproducible from the sample.

steps.title: Report SLA attainment against target with variance commentary
sop: Compute scan and index SLA attainment percentages against their targets.
Write variance commentary naming the cause for any miss.
State the corrective action taken or planned for each miss.
Done when every SLA miss carries commentary and an action.
verify: Read the report for a miss shown without commentary.
Pass when every miss carries commentary and an action.

steps.title: Assemble the daily intake report in the workflow reporting module
sop: Assemble volume, routing accuracy, index error and SLA sections into the report.
Include the extract timestamp and the report version.
Review the assembled report for internal consistency between sections.
Done when the report is assembled with all four sections.
verify: Check the report contains volume, accuracy, error rate and SLA sections.
Pass when all four sections are present and populated.

steps.title: Distribute the report to operations management by the cut-off
sop: Send the report to the operations management distribution list.
Complete distribution before the published morning cut-off time.
Record the distribution timestamp against the report version.
Done when the report is distributed inside the cut-off.
verify: Compare the distribution timestamp to the published cut-off.
Pass when distribution occurred before the cut-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: All classified and indexed documents awaiting routing to new business, endorsement, claims, service or billing queues.
generic.In-scope period: Current intake day, from classification release to routing confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Destination queue, document type, product line and the linked policy or claim record id.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Routed document count equals the classified and indexed document count for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing event stored with rules table version, router id and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Misrouted items are bounced back to intake with a reason code recorded.
generic.Test population: All documents routed during the intake day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero routed documents unlinked to a record in the policy admin system.
generic.Exception handling path: Items needing two destinations are linked rather than duplicated as separate images.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Destination queue matches the routing rules table output for the document type and product line.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool routing history plus the document link on the policy admin record.

steps.title: Derive the destination queue from the routing rules table
sop: Read document type and product line from the indexed document profile.
Let the routing rules table return the destination work queue.
Hold items where the rules table returns no destination.
Done when every document carries a rules-derived destination queue.
verify: Sample twelve routed documents and re-derive the queue from the rules table.
Pass when every sampled queue matches the rules output.

steps.title: Attach the document to the policy or claim record in the policy admin system
sop: Use the indexed identifier to open the policy or claim record in the admin system.
Attach the document to that record as part of the routing action.
Do not leave the image standing alone in the DMS after routing.
Done when every routed document is attached to its record.
verify: Query routed documents with no admin system record link.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Link dual-destination items rather than duplicating images
sop: Identify documents needing two destinations such as claims plus underwriting.
Create a link to the second queue from the single stored image.
Never create a duplicate image to satisfy a second destination.
Done when dual-destination items are linked from one image.
verify: Search the day's routed set for duplicate images of the same document.
Pass when no duplicate image exists for a dual-destination item.

steps.title: Release the routed documents into the workflow work queues
sop: Release the routed batch into the workflow/case management tool queues.
Confirm each item is visible in its destination queue after release.
Hold back any item that failed to release for re-drive.
Done when all routed documents are visible in their queues.
verify: Compare released count to landed count per destination queue.
Pass when released and landed counts agree per queue.

steps.title: Bounce misrouted items back to intake with a reason code
sop: Accept misroute returns from downstream teams into the intake queue.
Record the misroute reason code on the document profile.
Re-route from intake rather than forwarding the item team to team.
Done when every misroute is back at intake with a reason code.
verify: Read the misroute log for entries with no reason code.
Pass when every misroute entry carries a reason code.

steps.title: Control routing rule changes through the change process
sop: Raise any routing rules table change through the documented change process.
Re-test the amended rules against sample document types before go-live.
Record the rules table version applied on the routing history.
Done when the rule change is tested, approved and versioned.
verify: Compare the live rules table version to the approved change record.
Pass when the live version matches the approved change.

generic.Defined scope/population: All prepped physical batches queued at the scan station for image capture into OpenText.
generic.In-scope period: Current scanning shift, from batch pickup to physical batch quarantine.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scanner profile, batch id, image count and commit confirmation on every batch.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Committed image count equals the batch header sheet item count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Commit confirmation in OpenText with operator id and capture timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Jams and misfeeds are logged with the affected document and its full rescan outcome.
generic.Test population: Every batch scanned during the shift.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A viewable DMS image exists for every item on the batch header sheet.
generic.Exception handling path: Jammed documents are rescanned in full rather than by inserting single pages.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Barcode separators drove the document breaks and the image opens from the DMS.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText batch commit log and the dated paper quarantine bin register.

steps.title: Set the scanner profile for the document type before the run
sop: Read the document type from the batch header sheet.
Select the standard resolution and colour mode profile for that type.
Confirm duplex is enabled where the batch contains double-sided items.
Done when the correct scanner profile is loaded for the batch.
verify: Read the profile recorded on the committed batch record in OpenText.
Pass when the recorded profile matches the standard for the document type.

steps.title: Scan the batch in sequence with barcode separators driving breaks
sop: Feed the batch in header sheet sequence without reordering documents.
Let the barcode separators create the document breaks.
Stop the run if separators are not being read and reprint them.
Done when the batch is scanned with clean document breaks.
verify: Compare the document count produced to the separator count in the batch.
Pass when document count equals separator count.

steps.title: Resolve jams and misfeeds by rescanning the whole document
sop: Stop the run at any jam or misfeed and identify the affected document.
Delete the partial image and rescan that document in full.
Log the jam and the rescan outcome on the batch record.
Done when no partial image remains from a jam or misfeed.
verify: Review the batch for documents with missing or duplicated pages.
Pass when no document shows missing or duplicated pages.

steps.title: Commit the images to OpenText and confirm they open
sop: Commit the scanned batch into OpenText Document Mgmt.
Open a sample of the committed images from the DMS viewer.
Do not release the physical batch until images are confirmed viewable.
Done when the batch is committed and sampled images open.
verify: Open every document on the batch header sheet from the DMS.
Pass when every header sheet item has a viewable image.

steps.title: Reconcile committed image count to the batch header sheet
sop: Read the committed image count from the OpenText batch record.
Compare it against the item count on the batch header sheet.
Rescan or investigate any variance before the batch moves on.
Done when the counts agree.
verify: Re-read both counts after any corrective rescan.
Pass when committed image count equals header sheet count.

steps.title: Place paper originals in the dated quarantine bin
sop: Move the scanned physical batch into the dated quarantine bin.
Record the quarantine start date on the bin register.
Hold the batch for the full retention-quarantine period before destruction.
Done when the batch is in quarantine with its date recorded.
verify: Check the destruction pickup list against quarantine start dates.
Pass when no batch is released for destruction before its quarantine elapses.

generic.Defined scope/population: All form and notice templates selected for composition where a state-specific edition applies.
generic.In-scope period: Current composition cycle, covering transactions effective in the period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date, risk state and filed-and-approved status on each selected form.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms in the composed package reconcile to the forms schedule on the declarations page.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Composed package retains the form edition dates used and the composition timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms with no approved state edition are held and logged for filing follow-up.
generic.Test population: All packages composed in the cycle for states with edition-specific requirements.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No superseded form edition is selectable in the production template library.
generic.Exception handling path: Unapproved or unfiled editions block composition rather than defaulting to the latest edition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Edition matches the version approved for the risk state and the transaction effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin forms library plus the form filing inventory held in the DMS.

steps.title: Read risk state and effective date from the policy admin transaction
sop: Open the transaction in the policy admin system and read the risk state.
Read the transaction effective date that drives edition selection.
Note where risk state differs from mailing state.
Done when risk state and effective date are confirmed for the transaction.
verify: Re-read both values from the policy record.
Pass when the values used for selection match the policy record.

steps.title: Select the form edition approved for that state and effective date
sop: Query the forms library for editions approved for the risk state.
Select the edition in force at the transaction effective date.
Do not default to the latest edition where an earlier one applies.
Done when every form carries a state-and-date appropriate edition.
verify: Sample eight forms and re-derive the edition from the forms library.
Pass when every sampled edition matches the library result.

steps.title: Confirm filed-and-approved status against the filing inventory
sop: Open the form filing inventory held in the document management repository.
Confirm each selected edition shows filed-and-approved status for that state.
Block production use of any edition without approved status.
Done when every selected edition is confirmed filed and approved.
verify: Trace each selected edition to its filing inventory entry.
Pass when every edition has an approved filing entry.

steps.title: Check mandatory state language on the composed output
sop: Render a proof of the composed package for the risk state.
Confirm fraud warning, cancellation rights and appeal rights language is present.
Check the language is not truncated at a page break.
Done when all mandatory state language is present and complete.
verify: Re-read the rendered proof against the state language checklist.
Pass when every required statement appears in full.

steps.title: Apply effective-dating so in-force policies keep their edition
sop: Set effective-dating on the template so selection is driven by policy inception.
Confirm in-force policies continue to compose on their inception edition.
Test a renewal and a mid-term endorsement to confirm the behaviour.
Done when effective-dating produces the correct edition on both tests.
verify: Compose a test endorsement on an in-force policy.
Pass when the endorsement composes on the inception-date edition.

steps.title: Retire superseded editions from the production template library
sop: List editions superseded by a newly approved version.
Retire them in the policy admin template library so they cannot be picked.
Retain the retired edition for historic reprint but block new selection.
Done when no superseded edition is selectable in production.
verify: Attempt to select a retired edition in the production library.
Pass when the retired edition cannot be selected.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every document distributed in the cycle that must be archived onto its policy record.
generic.In-scope period: Current distribution day, from vendor or channel confirmation to archive commit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, transaction id, document date and retention class on the archived copy.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived document count equals the distributed document count for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived rendered PDF stored with archive timestamp and the version distributed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Archive failures appear on the daily reconciliation with the re-archive outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All documents distributed during the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every distributed document id has a matching archived image on the policy record.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing archives are re-archived from the rendered output, never re-composed from current data.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived copy is the exact rendered PDF sent and is stored non-erasable and non-rewriteable.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText policy document folder and the daily archive-versus-distribution reconciliation.

steps.title: Capture the exact rendered PDF that was distributed
sop: Take the rendered output file produced for distribution, not a fresh composition.
Confirm the file hash or render id matches the distributed package.
Reject any re-composition from current policy data as the archive copy.
Done when the exact distributed rendering is held for archive.
verify: Compare the archive candidate render id to the distribution record.
Pass when the render ids match.

steps.title: Index the archived copy to policy number, transaction id and date
sop: Read policy number and transaction id from the policy admin transaction.
Key those values plus the document date onto the archive index in OpenText.
Reject any archive commit missing an index value.
Done when all three index values are populated on the archived copy.
verify: Query archived documents for blank policy number or transaction id.
Pass when no archived document is missing an index value.

steps.title: Assign the retention class at the point of archive
sop: Derive the retention class for the document type from the retention schedule.
Set the class and retention trigger on the archived record in OpenText.
Hold any document whose type is absent from the schedule.
Done when every archived document carries a retention class.
verify: Query archived documents with a null retention class.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Commit the archive to non-erasable non-rewriteable storage
sop: Commit the archived copy into the records-format compliant store in OpenText.
Confirm the storage class prevents overwrite and deletion.
Escalate any document written to a mutable location.
Done when the archived copy sits in compliant storage.
verify: Attempt an overwrite on a sampled archived document.
Pass when the overwrite is rejected by the store.

steps.title: Run the daily archive-versus-distribution reconciliation
sop: Extract the distributed document id list from the policy admin system.
Extract the archived document id list from OpenText for the same day.
Compare the two lists and list any distributed id with no archive.
Done when the reconciliation is run and differences are listed.
verify: Recompute the comparison after remediating gaps.
Pass when every distributed id has a matching archive.

steps.title: Confirm the archived documents appear on the policy document list
sop: Open a sample of policy records in the policy admin system.
Confirm the archived documents appear on the policy document list.
Re-link any archived document not visible from the policy record.
Done when sampled policies show their distributed documents.
verify: Re-open the sampled policy document lists after re-linking.
Pass when no distributed document is missing from the policy list.

generic.Defined scope/population: All document production requests queued for composition through the template engine in the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current composition batch window, from job start to release to distribution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured, address, coverage limits, deductibles, premium and effective dates merged from the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Composed package count equals the queued production request count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Composition job log retained with job id, template version and completion timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Errored documents are held on the job log with the correction and recomposition outcome.
generic.Test population: All packages composed in the batch window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Composition job completes with zero errored documents on the job log.
generic.Exception handling path: Merge failures and empty placeholders are trapped and held before print rather than released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package assembled as declarations, forms schedule, endorsements then notices with continuous pagination.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin composition job log and the rendered package held in the DMS.

steps.title: Load the queued production requests into the composition job
sop: Select the validated production requests waiting in the composition queue.
Confirm each carries policy number, transaction id and document set.
Load the selected requests into the composition job in the policy admin system.
Done when the job is loaded with the full queued population.
verify: Compare loaded request count to the queued request count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Merge variable data from the policy admin record without re-keying
sop: Map named insured, address, limits, deductibles, premium and dates from the policy record.
Run the merge so no value is manually typed into the package.
Reject any request needing a manual value and correct the source record first.
Done when all variable data is merged from the system of record.
verify: Proof five packages against their policy admin records.
Pass when every proofed value matches the policy record.

steps.title: Assemble the package in the mandated document order
sop: Assemble declarations page first, then forms schedule, endorsements and notices.
Confirm the assembly rule set matches the mandated order.
Correct any package assembled out of order before release.
Done when every package follows the mandated order.
verify: Open three rendered packages and read the section sequence.
Pass when every package follows declarations, schedule, endorsements, notices.

steps.title: Trap merge failures and empty placeholders before print
sop: Run the placeholder scan across the rendered output in the DMS.
Hold any package containing an unresolved merge token or empty variable.
Return held packages for data correction and recomposition.
Done when no held package carries an unresolved placeholder.
verify: Search the released rendering for merge token text.
Pass when no released package contains placeholder text.

steps.title: Verify page numbering continuity across the assembled package
sop: Check the page X of Y numbering runs continuously across all sections.
Confirm the Y total equals the actual assembled page count.
Hold packages where numbering restarts or the total is wrong.
Done when pagination is continuous and correct on the sample.
verify: Re-read pagination on the sampled packages after correction.
Pass when numbering is continuous and totals match page counts.

steps.title: Review the composition job log before release to distribution
sop: Open the composition job log and read the errored document list.
Hold the batch where any document errored.
Release to distribution only once the errored list is empty.
Done when the batch is released with a clean job log.
verify: Re-read the job log after the release decision.
Pass when the released job shows zero errored documents.

generic.Defined scope/population: All composed packages awaiting a delivery channel decision for insured and agent copies.
generic.In-scope period: Current distribution cycle, before the channel is committed on the distribution request.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Delivery preference, consent record reference, document class and agent-copy routing.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Channel decisions issued equal composed packages awaiting distribution.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Distribution request stores the preference and consent record referenced with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with no preference or consent are defaulted to paper and flagged for capture.
generic.Test population: All distribution requests created in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No document routed electronically without a corresponding active consent record.
generic.Exception handling path: State-excluded document types are forced to paper regardless of the stored preference.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Preference read for the specific document class with agent routing decided separately.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin distribution request, the CRM preference record and the portal consent record.

steps.title: Read the delivery preference for the document class in the policy admin system
sop: Open the policy record and read the delivery preference for this document class.
Do not apply a policy-level preference to a class it does not cover.
Note where no class-level preference exists.
Done when the class-level preference is established or shown absent.
verify: Re-read the preference on a sample of distribution requests.
Pass when the recorded preference matches the class-level value.

steps.title: Confirm an active e-consent record before selecting electronic delivery
sop: Open the consent record in the Customer Self-Service Portal for the party.
Confirm consent is active, in scope and not revoked.
Treat preference without consent as insufficient for electronic delivery.
Done when electronic selections are backed by an active consent record.
verify: Query electronic distribution requests with no active consent reference.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Apply state e-delivery exclusions as a hard paper override
sop: Check the document type against the state e-delivery exclusion list.
Force paper where the state excludes the type regardless of preference.
Record the override reason on the distribution request.
Done when all excluded types are set to paper.
verify: Search the electronic distribution set for an excluded document type.
Pass when no excluded type is set to electronic.

steps.title: Determine agent-copy routing separately in the CRM
sop: Read the agent-of-record contact and delivery preference in the CRM.
Set the agent copy channel independently of the insured copy channel.
Suppress the agent copy where the product does not require one.
Done when agent-copy routing is set independently.
verify: Compare agent and insured channels on a sample of requests.
Pass when agent routing reflects the CRM agent preference.

steps.title: Default to paper and flag the record where no preference exists
sop: Identify parties with no stored preference and no consent record.
Set the distribution channel to paper for those parties.
Flag the record in the CRM for preference and consent capture at next contact.
Done when all no-preference parties are on paper and flagged.
verify: Query no-preference parties routed to an electronic channel.
Pass when no such party exists.

steps.title: Commit the channel on the distribution request with its driving record
sop: Write the selected channel onto the distribution request in the policy admin system.
Reference the preference or consent record that drove the decision.
Lock the channel so downstream steps cannot silently change it.
Done when every request carries a channel and its driving reference.
verify: Query distribution requests missing a channel or a driving reference.
Pass when no request is missing either value.

generic.Defined scope/population: All released distribution packages awaiting transmission over paper, email or portal channels.
generic.In-scope period: Current distribution day, from print file transmission to vendor acknowledgement matching.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Print file id, piece count, mail class, sending domain and vendor acknowledgement reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Vendor acknowledged piece count matches the released package count piece for piece.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Vendor acknowledgement file retained with transmission and acknowledgement timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendor SLA breaches on mail-drop turnaround are logged with the vendor response.
generic.Test population: All distribution packages released during the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No released distribution package lacks a vendor or channel confirmation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched pieces hold the job open until reconciled with the print vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Print file transmitted over the secure channel with mail class correct for the document type.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin distribution log, the vendor acknowledgement file and the portal posting log.

steps.title: Transmit the print file to the print vendor over the secure channel
sop: Generate the print file from the released packages in the policy admin system.
Transmit it to the print and mail vendor over the approved secure channel.
Record the transmission timestamp and file id on the distribution log.
Done when the print file is transmitted and logged.
verify: Read the transmission log entry for the file.
Pass when the file shows a successful secure transmission record.

steps.title: Match the vendor acknowledgement file to the transmitted print file
sop: Retrieve the vendor acknowledgement file for the transmitted job.
Match acknowledgement to file id and confirm the vendor accepted the job.
Chase the vendor where no acknowledgement arrives within the agreed window.
Done when an acknowledgement is matched to every transmitted file.
verify: Query transmitted files with no matched acknowledgement.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Reconcile vendor piece counts against released packages
sop: Read the vendor acknowledged piece count from the acknowledgement file.
Compare it piece for piece against the released package count.
Hold the job open until any variance is resolved with the vendor.
Done when acknowledged and released counts reconcile.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation after vendor correction.
Pass when acknowledged pieces equal released pieces.

steps.title: Apply the correct mail class and postage tier by document type
sop: Set first class for statutory notices and standard class for marketing material.
Confirm the mail class on the print file header matches the document type.
Correct and retransmit where the class is wrong.
Done when every package carries the correct mail class.
verify: Sample the print file header records by document type.
Pass when every sampled statutory notice is set to first class.

steps.title: Send email distributions from the approved domain with secure links
sop: Send electronic distributions from the approved corporate sending domain.
Place documents containing PII behind a secure portal link rather than attaching them.
Record the send event on the distribution log in the DMS.
Done when all email distributions are sent and recorded.
verify: Review sent email records for attachments containing PII.
Pass when no PII document was sent as a direct attachment.

steps.title: Monitor vendor mail-drop turnaround against the contracted SLA
sop: Read mail-drop dates from the vendor confirmation file for each job.
Compare elapsed business days against the contracted turnaround SLA.
Log every breach with the vendor reference and response.
Done when turnaround is measured and breaches are logged.
verify: Read the vendor SLA log for the period.
Pass when every breach carries a logged vendor response.

generic.Defined scope/population: All distributed documents requiring a delivery confirmation or e-consent acknowledgement.
generic.In-scope period: Current confirmation cycle, from distribution send to confirmation capture or fallback.
