generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document id, delivery or bounce status, retrieval event and consent version acknowledged.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmation records equal the number of documents distributed in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmation stored against the document id with the event timestamp and consent version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounces and undeliverables carry a logged paper fallback action and its date.
generic.Test population: All documents distributed in the cycle across paper, email and portal.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No bounced electronic delivery is left without a fallback action.
generic.Exception handling path: Bounces trigger paper fallback within the required timeframe rather than silent failure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Confirmation stored per document id, with proof of mailing where the item is a statutory notice.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin delivery history, portal retrieval events and the DMS confirmation record.

steps.title: Capture email delivery receipts and bounce status per document id
sop: Pull delivery receipt and bounce events from the send platform for the cycle.
Match each event to the document id rather than only to the mailbox.
Write the delivery status onto the document record in the DMS.
Done when every emailed document carries a delivery status.
verify: Query emailed documents with no delivery or bounce status.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm portal posting with a retrieval or view event
sop: Read the notification-sent event and the retrieval or view event from the portal.
Record both events against the document id as delivery evidence.
Treat a posting with no notification event as incomplete delivery.
Done when portal documents carry both events or a gap is raised.
verify: Sample portal-delivered documents for both event types.
Pass when every sampled document shows a notification and a view event.

steps.title: Obtain proof of mailing for statutory notices
sop: Identify distributed items classified as statutory notices.
Obtain the certified or proof-of-mailing evidence from the vendor file.
Store the evidence reference against the document in the DMS.
Done when every statutory notice carries mailing evidence.
verify: Query statutory notices with no proof-of-mailing reference.
Pass when no statutory notice lacks mailing evidence.

steps.title: Trigger paper fallback for bounces within the required timeframe
sop: List hard bounces and confirmed undeliverable electronic deliveries.
Raise a paper distribution for each within the required timeframe.
Record the fallback action and its date against the document.
Done when every bounce has a fallback action recorded.
verify: Read the bounce list for entries with no fallback record.
Pass when every bounce carries a fallback record.

steps.title: Record the consent version acknowledged at delivery
sop: Read the consent version in force for the party at the delivery date.
Store that version alongside the delivery confirmation record.
Flag deliveries where the consent version cannot be established.
Done when every electronic confirmation names a consent version.
verify: Sample electronic confirmations for a stored consent version.
Pass when every sampled confirmation names a consent version.

steps.title: Reconcile confirmations to distributed documents in the policy admin system
sop: Extract the distributed document list for the cycle from the policy admin system.
Match each to a stored confirmation, fallback or mailing evidence entry.
Chase any document with no confirmation of any kind.
Done when every distributed document maps to a confirmation or fallback.
verify: Recompute the match after chasing gaps.
Pass when no distributed document lacks a confirmation or fallback.

generic.Defined scope/population: The QA sample drawn from each composed batch before it is released to distribution.
generic.In-scope period: Current composition batch, reviewed between composition completion and release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured, mailing address, policy number, effective dates, limits and premium on the sample.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms schedule count on the declarations page equals endorsements present in the package.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: QA review record holds reviewer, sample size, pass or fail result and review timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Defects are logged as systemic or item-level with the batch hold decision recorded.
generic.Test population: The sampled packages from each composed batch in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No batch reaches Released status with an open critical QA defect.
generic.Exception handling path: Systemic template or data-mapping defects stop the whole batch, not just the sampled item.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sampled data matches the admin record and mandatory state notices are present and untruncated.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin QA review record and the rendered proof packages held in the DMS.

steps.title: Draw the QA sample from the composed batch in the DMS
sop: Determine the sample size for the batch from the QA sampling standard.
Draw the sample across document types and states present in the batch.
Record the sample size and selection basis on the QA review record.
Done when the sample is drawn and recorded.
verify: Compare the drawn sample size to the sampling standard for the batch size.
Pass when the sample meets the standard.

steps.title: Proof variable data against the policy admin record
sop: Open each sampled package alongside its policy admin record.
Proof named insured, address, policy number, effective dates, limits and premium.
Record every mismatch with the field name on the QA record.
Done when all sampled packages are proofed field by field.
verify: Re-proof two sampled packages independently.
Pass when the independent proof finds no additional mismatch.

steps.title: Reconcile the forms schedule to endorsements present in the package
sop: Read the forms schedule listed on the declarations page.
Confirm each listed endorsement is physically present in the package.
Record any listed-but-missing or present-but-unlisted form as a defect.
Done when schedule and package contents reconcile on the sample.
verify: Recount forms in the package against the schedule after correction.
Pass when schedule and package contents agree.

steps.title: Check mandatory state notices are present and untruncated
sop: List the mandatory notices required for the risk state and transaction type.
Confirm each appears in the sampled package in full.
Check that no notice text is cut off at a page break.
Done when all mandatory notices are confirmed present and complete.
verify: Re-read the notice sections on the sampled packages.
Pass when every required notice is present and untruncated.

steps.title: Check the address block for window fit and standardisation
sop: Confirm the address block sits within the window envelope template area.
Confirm the address is standardised to the postal format.
Hold packages where the address overflows or is unstandardised.
Done when address blocks pass the window fit check.
verify: Overlay the window template on the sampled address blocks.
Pass when every sampled address sits inside the window area.

steps.title: Record the pass or fail result and hold systemic defects
sop: Classify each defect as item-level or systemic template or data-mapping.
Hold the whole batch where any systemic defect is found.
Record reviewer, sample size and result on the QA review record before release.
Done when the QA result is recorded and the hold decision is applied.
verify: Check Released batches for an open critical QA defect.
Pass when no Released batch carries an open critical defect.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documents in the cycle with an electronic channel decision destined for the policyholder portal.
generic.In-scope period: Current posting cycle, from distribution release to availability confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Portal account id, policy id, document title, document date and category on every posting.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal posted count equals the electronic distribution count for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Portal posting timestamp written back to policy history as the delivery event.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suppressed or failed postings are logged with the paper fallback outcome.
generic.Test population: All documents posted to the portal in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No portal-posted document is visible on an account other than the intended one.
generic.Exception handling path: State paper-only document types are suppressed from portal posting and routed to print.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Document opens as the customer under the intended policy with a meaningful title and category.
generic.Evidence location: Customer Self-Service Portal document list and the policy admin delivery history.

steps.title: Resolve the portal account for the policy in the policy admin system
sop: Read the party and policy identifiers from the distribution request.
Resolve the linked portal account id in the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Hold postings where the account cannot be resolved unambiguously.
Done when every posting has a resolved portal account.
verify: Sample resolved accounts against party records in the policy admin system.
Pass when every sampled account belongs to the intended policyholder.

steps.title: Suppress postings for paper-only document types
sop: Check each document type against the state paper-only exclusion list.
Suppress portal posting for excluded types and route them to print.
Record the suppression reason on the distribution record.
Done when no excluded type remains in the posting set.
verify: Search the posted set for a paper-only document type.
Pass when no excluded type was posted.

steps.title: Post the document to the portal with title, date and category
sop: Upload the rendered document to the resolved portal account.
Set a customer-readable title, the document date and the document category.
Attach the posting to the correct policy on that account.
Done when the document is posted with complete display metadata.
verify: Read the portal document list entry for the posting.
Pass when title, date and category are populated and readable.

steps.title: Confirm availability by opening the document as the customer would
sop: Open the document from the customer-facing portal document list.
Confirm it renders fully and is not truncated or corrupted.
Do not rely on the upload log alone as confirmation.
Done when the document opens successfully from the customer view.
verify: Re-open a sample of postings from the customer view.
Pass when every sampled document opens successfully.

steps.title: Retry failed uploads and escalate repeat failures to paper
sop: List postings that failed upload or failed the availability check.
Retry the upload once and re-run the availability check.
Escalate repeat failures to paper fallback rather than leaving them queued.
Done when no failed posting remains without a retry or fallback.
verify: Read the posting failure log for entries with no retry or fallback.
Pass when every failure carries a retry or fallback outcome.

steps.title: Write the posting timestamp back to policy history
sop: Write the portal posting timestamp into policy history as the delivery event.
Record channel as portal and name the document posted.
Confirm service staff can see the event on the policy record.
Done when every successful posting has a policy history delivery event.
verify: Query posted documents with no policy history delivery event.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open re-issuance requests for lost, damaged, undelivered or customer-requested copies.
generic.In-scope period: Current service day, from request receipt to reissue despatch.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requester authentication result, reissue reason, delivery channel and original issue date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reissue events recorded in policy history equal reissue requests completed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Policy history reissue event carries reason, channel, timestamp and the document version sent.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests that fail authentication are refused and logged with the refusal reason.
generic.Test population: All reissue requests completed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No reissue is sent to an address still flagged undeliverable.
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable originals require an address correction in the admin system before reissue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived original re-sent unless the request is expressly for current terms.
generic.Evidence location: CRM service interaction record and the policy admin policy history reissue event.

steps.title: Authenticate the requester against the policy record
sop: Open the policy record in the policy admin system for the quoted policy number.
Verify the requester against the authentication standard before disclosing anything.
Refuse and log the request where authentication fails.
Done when the requester is authenticated or the request is refused.
verify: Read the CRM interaction record for an authentication outcome.
Pass when every reissue carries a recorded authentication pass.

steps.title: Determine whether the archived original or a current version applies
sop: Clarify whether the customer wants the item as originally issued or current terms.
Retrieve the archived original from the DMS for lost or undelivered copies.
Compose a current version only where the request is expressly for current terms.
Done when the correct source document is selected.
verify: Compare the despatched document to the recorded request type.
Pass when the document sent matches the request type.

steps.title: Correct the mailing address in the policy admin system first
sop: Check whether the original was returned undeliverable.
Correct and validate the mailing address on the policy record before reissue.
Clear the undeliverable flag only once the new address is validated.
Done when the address is corrected and validated for undeliverable cases.
verify: Query reissues despatched to an address still flagged undeliverable.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Mark the copy as a reissue preserving the original issue date
sop: Apply the reissue marking to the outgoing copy.
Preserve the original issue date on the document face.
Ensure the item is not presented as a new transaction.
Done when the copy is marked as a reissue with the original date intact.
verify: Read the despatched copy for its issue date and reissue marking.
Pass when the original issue date is preserved and the reissue marking is present.

steps.title: Despatch the reissue on the confirmed delivery channel
sop: Release the reissue to the channel confirmed with the customer.
Confirm consent is active where the reissue is electronic.
Record the despatch reference on the CRM interaction.
Done when the reissue is despatched and referenced.
verify: Match despatch references to completed reissue requests.
Pass when every completed request has a despatch reference.

steps.title: Write the reissue event to policy history with its reason
sop: Record a reissue event in policy history in the policy admin system.
Select the reason from lost, damaged, undelivered or customer request.
Record the delivery channel used on the same event.
Done when every reissue has a policy history event with reason and channel.
verify: Query completed reissues with no policy history event.
Pass when no completed reissue is missing its event.

generic.Defined scope/population: All document production triggers raised by the policy admin system plus logged manual requests.
generic.In-scope period: Current processing day, from trigger receipt to queueing for composition.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, transaction id, document set and effective date on every request payload.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Queued production requests equal triggers received less suppressed duplicates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request record holds trigger source, receipt timestamp and payload version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interface errors sit on the error queue with the re-drive outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All production triggers received during the processing day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No unprocessed production trigger remains in the interface error queue overnight.
generic.Exception handling path: Payloads failing field validation are rejected back to the source rather than queued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Request record exists with policy number, transaction id and document set for every trigger.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin interface log, the workflow error queue and the DMS request register.

steps.title: Receive issuance and change triggers from the policy admin system
sop: Monitor the production trigger interface for issuance, endorsement, renewal and cancellation events.
Confirm each event type in scope is generating a trigger.
Record trigger source and receipt timestamp on the request register.
Done when all triggers for the day are received and registered.
verify: Compare triggers received to transactions completed for the day.
Pass when every in-scope transaction generated a trigger.

steps.title: Validate the request payload fields before queueing
sop: Check policy number, transaction id, document set and effective date are present.
Reject payloads with a missing or malformed field back to the source.
Queue only fully validated payloads for composition.
Done when every queued request passed field validation.
verify: Query queued requests with a missing required field.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Suppress duplicate triggers for the same transaction id
sop: Group incoming triggers by transaction id and document set.
Suppress the second and later triggers for the same combination.
Log each suppression so a genuine re-trigger can be distinguished.
Done when no duplicate remains in the composition queue.
verify: Search the queue for two requests sharing a transaction id and document set.
Pass when no duplicate pair exists.

steps.title: Clear the interface error queue in the workflow tool daily
sop: Open the production trigger error queue in the workflow tool.
Diagnose each error and re-drive the trigger where the payload is now valid.
Escalate errors that cannot be re-driven inside the SLA.
Done when the error queue is empty or every entry is escalated.
verify: Read the error queue at end of day.
Pass when no unprocessed trigger remains overnight.

steps.title: Log manual production requests with requester and reason
sop: Accept manual requests only through the logged request route.
Record requester, reason and target document set in the DMS request register.
Refuse console-run production that bypasses the register.
Done when every manual request is logged before it runs.
verify: Compare manually produced packages to register entries.
Pass when every manual production has a register entry.

steps.title: Register the validated requests for composition in the DMS
sop: Create the production request record with policy number, transaction id and document set.
Set the request status to Ready for Composition.
Confirm the composition queue picks up the registered requests.
Done when all validated requests are registered and queued.
verify: Compare registered request count to validated trigger count.
Pass when the counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every copy sent to an insured, additional insured, mortgagee or agent in the distribution cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current distribution cycle, from vendor or channel confirmation to policy history write.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Delivery date, channel and recipient type recorded per copy sent.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Delivery history entries equal the number of copies distributed in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Policy history entry holds the confirmation source and its reference with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed and returned deliveries are recorded as delivery events with the failure reason.
generic.Test population: All copies distributed during the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No distributed statutory notice lacks a proof-of-mailing reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Returned mail is recorded against the copy rather than left blank in delivery history.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Paper delivery date is the vendor mail-drop date, not the composition date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin policy history and the vendor mail-drop file retained in the DMS.

steps.title: Read the vendor mail-drop file for paper delivery dates
sop: Retrieve the vendor mail-drop confirmation file for the print job.
Read the mail-drop date for each piece in the job.
Use that date as the paper delivery date rather than the composition date.
Done when mail-drop dates are available for every paper piece.
verify: Compare recorded paper delivery dates to the vendor file dates.
Pass when every paper delivery date equals its mail-drop date.

steps.title: Record delivery date, channel and recipient per copy in policy history
sop: Create one policy history entry for each copy sent.
Record delivery date, channel and recipient type on each entry.
Do not collapse multiple recipients into a single entry.
Done when every copy has its own delivery history entry.
verify: Compare history entry count to the copies distributed for the transaction.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Store proof-of-mailing references for statutory notices
sop: Identify entries relating to statutory notices in the cycle.
Attach the proof-of-mailing or certified tracking reference to each entry.
Chase the vendor where the reference is not supplied.
Done when every statutory notice entry carries a mailing reference.
verify: Query statutory notice entries with a blank mailing reference.
Pass when no statutory notice entry is blank.

steps.title: Record failed and returned deliveries as delivery events
sop: Take returned mail and bounce reports for the cycle.
Record each as a delivery event with the failure reason on policy history.
Never leave the delivery entry blank for a failed attempt.
Done when every failure appears as a recorded delivery event.
verify: Match returned mail items to policy history failure events.
Pass when every returned item has a recorded failure event.

steps.title: Record electronic delivery confirmations against the same history
sop: Take portal view events and email delivery receipts for the cycle.
Record the confirmation date and channel on the matching history entry.
Distinguish notification sent from document retrieved on the entry.
Done when electronic copies carry a confirmation on policy history.
verify: Sample electronic copies for a recorded confirmation event.
Pass when every sampled electronic copy shows a confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm delivery history is visible to service staff on the policy record
sop: Open a sample of policy records as a service user in the policy admin system.
Confirm the delivery history is visible without special permissions.
Raise an access defect where the history cannot be seen.
Done when service staff can read delivery history on the sampled records.
verify: Re-open the sampled records under a service user profile.
Pass when delivery history is visible on every sampled record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documents distributed in the reporting month across paper, email and portal channels.
generic.In-scope period: Prior calendar month, reported on the published monthly cadence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Volume by channel and document class, failure counts by cause and vendor SLA attainment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported volumes reconcile to policy admin distribution counts for the month.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published report version stored with the extract date and reporting month.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Repeat undeliverable addresses are listed for address-cleansing follow-up.
generic.Test population: All distributions completed in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report contains channel mix, failure rate and vendor SLA sections for the month.
generic.Exception handling path: Vendor SLA breaches are itemised with the vendor response and remedy.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Failure rate is broken down by cause and channel mix is trended month over month.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin distribution extract and the monthly report stored in the DMS.

steps.title: Extract monthly distribution volumes by channel from the policy admin system
sop: Run the distribution extract for the reporting month in the policy admin system.
Split volumes by channel of paper, email and portal.
Split again by document class.
Done when volumes are extracted by channel and class.
verify: Reconcile extracted totals to the monthly distribution log.
Pass when extract totals equal the distribution log totals.

steps.title: Break the delivery failure rate down by cause
sop: Classify failures as bad address, bounced email, portal access failure or vendor error.
Compute the failure rate overall and by cause.
Reject a single blended failure number as the report figure.
Done when the failure rate is reported by cause.
verify: Sum the by-cause counts against the total failure count.
Pass when the by-cause counts sum to the total.

steps.title: Report print vendor turnaround against the contracted SLA
sop: Compute mail-drop turnaround in business days for each print job in the month.
Compare against the contracted turnaround SLA.
List every breach with the vendor reference and their response.
Done when vendor turnaround performance is computed and breaches listed.
verify: Recompute two turnaround figures from the vendor files.
Pass when the recomputed figures match the report.

steps.title: Trend the paper-to-electronic channel mix month over month
sop: Compute the paper and electronic share of total distributions for the month.
Place the figures alongside the prior months in the trend series.
Write commentary naming the drivers of any material movement.
Done when the channel mix trend and commentary are complete.
verify: Check the trend series against the prior published reports.
Pass when prior month figures match what was previously published.

steps.title: List repeat undeliverable addresses for cleansing
sop: Group returned mail by address across the month and prior months.
List addresses failing more than once for address-cleansing follow-up.
Assign the list to the data quality owner with a due date.
Done when the repeat undeliverable list is produced and assigned.
verify: Check the list entries carry an owner and a due date.
Pass when every listed address has an owner and due date.

steps.title: Issue the monthly distribution report and store it in the DMS
sop: Assemble channel mix, failure rate and vendor SLA sections into the report.
Issue it on the published monthly cadence to operations management.
Store the issued version in the document management repository.
Done when the report is issued and stored.
verify: Open the stored report and confirm all three sections are present.
Pass when the stored report contains all three sections.

generic.Defined scope/population: All transactions requiring a form set derived from state, product, coverages and transaction type.
generic.In-scope period: Current transaction processing cycle, before composition is triggered.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk state, product, coverage selections, transaction type and resulting form list.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms on the transaction equal the forms-attachment rule output plus logged manual additions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transaction audit trail holds the rules version and every manual form addition with its reason.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicting or superseded endorsements are recorded with the resolution applied.
generic.Test population: All transactions with a composed form set in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No mandatory state notice is missing from the selected form set.
generic.Exception handling path: Manual form additions require a reason and appear on the transaction audit trail.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Optional endorsements attach only where the matching coverage is rated on the policy.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin forms-attachment rule output and the transaction audit trail in the DMS.

steps.title: Run the forms-attachment rules against the transaction
sop: Read state, product, coverage selections and transaction type from the transaction.
Run the forms-attachment rules in the policy admin system.
Capture the resulting form list against the transaction.
Done when the rule-derived form set is attached to the transaction.
verify: Re-run the rules on a sample of transactions.
Pass when the attached list matches the rerun output.

steps.title: Confirm mandatory notices attached for the triggering event
sop: Identify triggering events such as cancellation, nonrenewal, adverse action or privacy.
Confirm the mandated notice for the state is present in the form set.
Block the transaction where a mandatory notice is missing.
Done when all triggered mandatory notices are attached.
verify: Compare the attached notices to the state trigger inventory.
Pass when every triggered notice is present.

steps.title: Restrict optional endorsements to rated coverages
sop: List optional and conditional endorsements in the attached set.
Confirm the matching coverage is actually rated on the policy.
Remove endorsements with no corresponding rated coverage.
Done when every optional endorsement maps to a rated coverage.
verify: Cross-check attached optional endorsements to the rating detail.
Pass when every optional endorsement has a rated coverage.

steps.title: Detect and resolve conflicting or superseded endorsements
sop: Run the endorsement conflict check across the attached form set.
Remove superseded editions and resolve mutually exclusive endorsements.
Record the resolution on the transaction before composition.
Done when no conflicting or superseded endorsement remains attached.
verify: Re-run the conflict check after resolution.
Pass when the conflict check returns no findings.

steps.title: Capture a reason for every manual form addition
sop: List forms added outside the rules output on the transaction.
Record the addition reason against each one.
Ensure the addition appears on the transaction audit trail.
Done when every manual addition carries a reason on the audit trail.
verify: Read the audit trail for manual additions with no reason.
Pass when every manual addition carries a reason.

steps.title: Freeze the form set and release it to composition
sop: Freeze the reviewed form set against the transaction in the policy admin system.
Record the rules version used on the transaction record.
Release the transaction to the composition queue.
Done when the frozen form set is released to composition.
verify: Compare the composed package contents to the frozen form set.
Pass when the composed package matches the frozen set.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every document and data item named in the regulator request across DMS, policy admin and claim repositories.
generic.In-scope period: The period stated in the regulator request, from request receipt to production assembly.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Request item, owner, due date, retrieval status and source system on the request list.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retrieved population reconciles to the requested population with gaps explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Production set is Bates-stamped or indexed with the assembly date and set version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Withheld or not-found items carry a documented reason on the request list.
generic.Test population: All items on the regulator document request list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every requested item shows retrieved, withheld with reason, or not found with explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Privileged and out-of-scope material is segregated for counsel review before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Search covered the DMS, policy admin system and claim file repository, not the DMS alone.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText production folder and the document request list held with the correspondence file.

steps.title: Parse the regulator request into a document request list
sop: Read the regulator letter and itemise each document and data request.
Create a request list row per item with owner and due date.
Confirm the requested period and population definition for each item.
Done when every request in the letter has a list row.
verify: Compare the list rows to the numbered requests in the letter.
Pass when every letter request maps to a list row.

steps.title: Search the DMS, policy admin system and claim repository
sop: Run the agreed search criteria in OpenText for each request item.
Repeat the search in the policy admin system and the claim file repository.
Record the search criteria used against each request row.
Done when all three sources have been searched for every item.
verify: Read the request list for rows searched in only one source.
Pass when every row shows searches across all three sources.

steps.title: Reconcile the retrieved population to the requested population
sop: Count the retrieved items against the defined requested population.
Investigate any shortfall such as missing policies in the sampled period.
Record an explanation for every residual gap.
Done when retrieved and requested populations reconcile or gaps are explained.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation after gap investigation.
Pass when every gap carries a recorded explanation.

steps.title: Segregate privileged and out-of-scope material for counsel
sop: Review the retrieved set for privileged or clearly out-of-scope material.
Move those items into the counsel review folder in OpenText.
Hold them out of the production set until counsel signs off.
Done when all candidate privileged material is segregated.
verify: Check the production-ready set for unreviewed privileged items.
Pass when no privileged item sits in the set without counsel sign-off.

steps.title: Bates-stamp and index the production set in OpenText
sop: Apply Bates stamping or an equivalent index to the production set.
Record the stamp range against each request list row.
Confirm every item can be cited by its stamp in the response.
Done when the production set is fully stamped and indexed.
verify: Spot-check ten production items for a unique stamp.
Pass when every sampled item carries a unique stamp.

steps.title: Close the request list with a status against every item
sop: Set each row to retrieved, withheld with reason, or not found with explanation.
Confirm no row is left with a blank status.
Hand the completed list and production set to the response drafter.
Done when every request row carries a final status.
verify: Read the request list for blank statuses.
Pass when no row has a blank status.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every question posed in the regulator letter and every exhibit cited in the answer.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the regulator letter to circulation of the review-ready draft.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Question number, answer text, supporting exhibit reference and reviewer assignment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Answered question count equals questions posed in the regulator letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft stored in the correspondence file with reviewer names, review dates and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questions that cannot be answered fully are flagged with the reason and the proposed position.
generic.Test population: All questions in the regulator letter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No question from the regulator letter is unanswered in the draft.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported assertions are removed or evidenced before the draft is circulated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every factual assertion ties to a system extract or exhibit and exhibits are cited in order.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint drafting workspace and the correspondence file in the DMS.

steps.title: Build the answer skeleton from the regulator letter in SharePoint
sop: Create the draft in the SharePoint correspondence workspace.
Enter every question from the regulator letter in order as a heading.
Leave no question out even where the answer is a referral.
Done when the skeleton lists every question in order.
verify: Count headings against numbered questions in the letter.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Draft an explicit answer under each question
sop: Write a direct answer under each question heading.
Avoid cross-references that leave a question effectively unanswered.
Mark any answer that is provisional pending further retrieval.
Done when every question carries a drafted answer.
verify: Read the draft for headings with no answer text.
Pass when no heading is left without an answer.

steps.title: Tie factual assertions to system extracts or exhibits
sop: List the factual assertions made in the draft.
Attach the supporting system extract or exhibit reference to each one.
Remove or rewrite assertions that cannot be supported.
Done when every assertion has a supporting reference.
verify: Sample eight assertions and open their supporting evidence.
Pass when every sampled assertion resolves to real evidence.

steps.title: Number and order the exhibits to match the citation sequence
sop: Assign exhibit numbers in the order they are first cited in the draft.
Assemble the exhibit bundle in that same order in the DMS.
Confirm every cited exhibit number exists in the bundle.
Done when exhibit numbering and bundle order match the citations.
verify: Walk the draft citations against the assembled bundle.
Pass when every citation resolves to the correct exhibit.

steps.title: Circulate the draft to compliance and legal counsel with a deadline
sop: Send the draft to compliance and legal counsel from the SharePoint workspace.
Set a review deadline that preserves time to file before the statutory date.
Record reviewer names and the deadline on the draft record.
Done when the draft is circulated with named reviewers and a deadline.
verify: Compare the review deadline to the statutory filing deadline.
Pass when the review deadline leaves time to finalise and file.

steps.title: Resolve comments in the tracked-changes version and file the draft
sop: Work reviewer comments in the tracked-changes version in SharePoint.
Retain the review trail rather than accepting into a clean copy only.
Store the review-ready draft in the correspondence file in the DMS.
Done when comments are resolved and the draft is filed.
verify: Open the filed draft and check reviewer names and review dates are present.
Pass when the filed draft records reviewers and review dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: All transaction events across written states that compel a regulatory notice.
generic.In-scope period: Current trigger inventory review cycle, including changes from the regulatory change feed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event, state, required notice, notice period, enforcing control and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Trigger inventory rows cover every event and state combination written.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Inventory version stored with review date and the change feed items considered.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Triggers with no automated enforcement are logged as manual-control risk and escalated.
generic.Test population: All catalogued triggers in the inventory.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No catalogued trigger lacks an assigned owner and an enforcing control.
generic.Exception handling path: New or amended triggers are added within the change-management SLA.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Inventory lists event, state, required notice and notice period for every trigger.
generic.Evidence location: Trigger inventory held in the DMS and the notice rules configured in the policy admin system.

steps.title: Map compelling transaction events to their required notices
sop: List transaction events such as cancellation, nonrenewal, premium increase and claim denial.
Map each event to the notice form and timing it compels.
Record the mapping as rows in the trigger inventory in the DMS.
Done when every compelling event has a mapped notice.
verify: Compare mapped events against the transaction type list in the policy admin system.
Pass when every in-scope transaction type is mapped.

steps.title: Maintain the inventory by state for differing notice periods
sop: Split each event row by state where notice periods differ.
Record the state-specific notice period on each row.
Avoid a single blended period across states.
Done when every event carries state-specific notice periods.
verify: Sample five event and state pairs against the state requirements source.
Pass when every sampled period matches the source.

steps.title: Pick up new and amended triggers from the regulatory change feed
sop: Review the regulatory change feed for notice-related statute and bulletin changes.
Add new triggers and amend existing rows within the change-management SLA.
Record the source citation and effective date on each changed row.
Done when all feed items are reflected in the inventory.
verify: Compare feed items in the period to inventory changes made.
Pass when every notice-related feed item has an inventory outcome.

steps.title: Link each trigger to the system rule or manual control that fires it
sop: Identify the policy admin system rule that generates each required notice.
Record the rule reference against the trigger row.
Name the manual control where no system rule exists.
Done when every trigger row names its enforcing control.
verify: Read the inventory for rows with a blank enforcing control.
Pass when no row has a blank enforcing control.

steps.title: Escalate triggers enforced only by a manual control
sop: List trigger rows enforced only by a manual control.
Flag each as manual-control risk on the inventory.
Escalate the list for automation prioritisation with an owner and date.
Done when every manual-control trigger is flagged and escalated.
verify: Read the escalation log against the manual-control flagged rows.
Pass when every flagged row appears on the escalation log.

steps.title: Assign an owner to every trigger and publish the inventory version
sop: Assign a named owner to each trigger row.
Publish the reviewed inventory version with its review date in the DMS.
Communicate the published version to the affected teams.
Done when the inventory is published with owners assigned.
verify: Read the published inventory for rows with no owner.
Pass when every trigger row carries a named owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All incoming regulatory correspondence received in the period requiring a log entry.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day, from compliance queue delivery to log entry completion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, regulator, state, reference number, topic, deadline, owner and reviewer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Log entries equal regulator items delivered to the compliance intake queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Log entry links to the imaged letter and the envelope image showing the postmark.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with an unclear deadline are logged with the assumed clock and the basis recorded.
generic.Test population: All regulator items logged during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open item has a null or past-dated response deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Deadline disputes are escalated to counsel before the calculated date is relied on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deadline is calculated from the correct statutory clock for that regulator.
generic.Evidence location: Correspondence log in the workflow tool and the imaged letter in the DMS.

steps.title: Create the log entry in the workflow correspondence log
sop: Open the correspondence log in the workflow/case management tool.
Create an entry for each item delivered to the compliance intake queue.
Key receipt date, regulator, state, reference number and topic.
Done when every delivered item has a log entry.
verify: Compare log entries to items in the compliance intake queue.
Pass when every queued item has a log entry.

steps.title: Calculate the response deadline from the correct statutory clock
sop: Determine whether the clock runs from receipt date or letter date for that regulator.
Compute the response deadline using that regulator's rule.
Record the basis used alongside the deadline.
Done when every entry carries a calculated deadline and its basis.
verify: Recompute three deadlines from the regulator rule reference.
Pass when the recomputed dates match the logged deadlines.

steps.title: Link the imaged letter and envelope to the log entry
sop: Locate the imaged inbound letter in the document management repository.
Link it and the envelope image showing the postmark to the log entry.
Chase intake where the envelope image is missing for a postmark-driven clock.
Done when every entry links to its letter and envelope images.
verify: Open the linked images from a sample of log entries.
Pass when every sampled entry opens both images.

steps.title: Assign the owner and reviewer at the point of logging
sop: Assign a named owner and a named reviewer on the log entry immediately.
Do not leave assignment until the item is triaged later.
Notify both parties from the workflow tool.
Done when every entry names an owner and a reviewer.
verify: Read the log for entries with a blank owner or reviewer.
Pass when no entry has a blank owner or reviewer.

steps.title: Set interim checkpoint reminders on the deadline calendar
sop: Create calendar reminders at the interim checkpoints for each item.
Include a draft-due checkpoint ahead of the response deadline.
Avoid setting a reminder only on the due date.
Done when every entry carries interim checkpoint reminders.
verify: Read the calendar entries for each open item.
Pass when every open item has at least one interim checkpoint.

steps.title: Review the log for null or past-dated deadlines on open items
sop: Filter the correspondence log for open items.
Identify any with a null or past-dated response deadline.
Correct the deadline or escalate the item the same day.
Done when no open item carries a null or past-dated deadline.
verify: Re-run the open item filter after corrections.
Pass when the filter returns no null or past-dated deadlines.

generic.Defined scope/population: All statutory notices produced in the period that require documented proof of mailing.
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting period, from notice production to proof-of-mailing entry lock.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, notice type, mailing date, evidence reference and vendor file reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Proof entries equal statutory notices produced in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certificate of mailing and vendor mail-drop file retained with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices with missing proof are logged as exceptions with the vendor chase outcome.
generic.Test population: All statutory notices produced during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No statutory notice produced in the period lacks a proof-of-mailing entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing certificates are chased with the vendor and recorded as vendor exceptions.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mailing date is the vendor mail-drop date and log entries are locked after commit.
generic.Evidence location: Proof-of-mailing log in the DMS and the retained vendor mail-drop files.

steps.title: Extract statutory notices produced from the policy admin system
sop: Run the statutory notice production extract for the period.
List policy number, notice type and production date for each.
Use this list as the expected proof-of-mailing population.
Done when the produced notice population is extracted.
verify: Reconcile the extract count to the notice production job logs.
Pass when the extract matches the production job counts.

steps.title: Record the vendor mail-drop date as the mailing date
sop: Read the mail-drop date per piece from the vendor confirmation file.
Record that date as the mailing date on the proof-of-mailing log.
Retain the vendor file itself as supporting evidence in the DMS.
Done when every notice carries a vendor-derived mailing date.
verify: Compare logged mailing dates to the vendor file for a sample.
Pass when every sampled date matches the vendor file.

steps.title: File certificates of mailing keyed to policy and notice type
sop: Obtain the certificate of mailing or USPS proof for each statutory notice.
Key it to the policy number and notice type on the log.
Store the certificate image in the DMS against the notice record.
Done when every notice has a filed certificate.
verify: Open certificates from a sample of log entries.
Pass when every sampled entry opens a certificate.

steps.title: File certified tracking numbers and return receipts
sop: Collect certified-mail tracking numbers and return receipts for the period.
File them against the notice record in the DMS.
Record the tracking reference on the proof-of-mailing log entry.
Done when all certified items carry a tracking reference and receipt.
verify: Query certified notices with no tracking reference.
Pass when no certified notice lacks a tracking reference.

steps.title: Reconcile the log against notices produced and chase gaps
sop: Compare the proof-of-mailing log to the produced notice extract.
List produced notices with no proof entry.
Chase the vendor inside the contracted turnaround and log the exception.
Done when every produced notice has a proof entry or a logged exception.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after the chase.
Pass when no produced notice is missing a proof entry.

steps.title: Lock committed log entries against retro-editing
sop: Commit the completed proof-of-mailing entries in the DMS.
Confirm the record lock prevents editing of mailing dates after commit.
Route any needed correction through an audited amendment instead.
Done when committed entries are locked.
verify: Attempt to edit a mailing date on a committed entry.
Pass when the edit is rejected by the system.

generic.Defined scope/population: All formal regulatory submissions requiring sign-off before filing in the period.
generic.In-scope period: From final draft completion to execution of the submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver name, role, approval date and the exact document version approved.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approval records equal the required sign-off levels for the submission type.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record names the document version and carries the approval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Post-approval edits are logged and re-routed for approval with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All submissions filed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No submission is filed on an approval that predates the final document version.
generic.Exception handling path: Absent or delegated approvers require verified delegation before approval is accepted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off levels match the approval authority matrix for the submission type and materiality.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint approval workflow record and the correspondence file in the DMS.

steps.title: Determine required sign-off levels from the authority matrix
sop: Read the submission type and materiality for the filing.
Look up the required sign-off levels in the approval authority matrix.
Record the required levels on the submission record.
Done when the required sign-off levels are recorded.
verify: Re-derive the levels from the matrix independently.
Pass when the recorded levels match the matrix.

steps.title: Capture compliance and legal approvals in SharePoint first
sop: Route the final draft to the compliance officer and legal counsel in SharePoint.
Capture both approvals before requesting the officer signature.
Record any conditions attached to an approval.
Done when compliance and legal approvals are captured.
verify: Read the approval sequence on the workflow record.
Pass when compliance and legal approvals precede the officer signature.

steps.title: Verify signature authority is current before execution
sop: Check the approver holds current authority for the record class and materiality.
Check for delegations or absences affecting the named approver.
Reject approvals from a lapsed or unauthorised approver.
Done when every approver's authority is verified as current.
verify: Match approvers to the current authority register.
Pass when every approver appears on the current register.

steps.title: Record name, role, date and document version on each approval
sop: Capture approver name, role and approval date on the approval record.
Name the exact document version approved on the same record.
Reject approvals that do not identify a version.
Done when every approval names a document version.
verify: Read the approval records for a missing version reference.
Pass when every approval names a version.

steps.title: Re-route any post-approval edit for fresh approval
sop: Compare the filing candidate version against the approved version.
Re-route the submission for approval where any edit was made after sign-off.
Record the edit and the re-approval on the workflow record.
Done when the filing version equals the approved version.
verify: Compare filing version to approval version on the record.
Pass when the two versions are identical.

steps.title: File the approval pack with the correspondence record in the DMS
sop: Assemble the approval records into the submission approval pack.
File the pack with the correspondence record in the document management repository.
Confirm the pack is retrievable by regulator and reference number.
Done when the approval pack is filed and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the pack by regulator and reference number.
Pass when the pack retrieves with all approval records present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All cancellation, nonrenewal, renewal and adverse-action notices triggered in the period.
generic.In-scope period: Current notice production cycle, measured from each trigger event date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger date, notice period, mailing date, effective date and state reason wording.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices produced equal notice triggers fired in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Production record holds trigger date, mailing date and the notice form edition used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missed or late notices are logged as exceptions with the re-noticing decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All statutory notices produced in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No statutory notice in the period was mailed after its regulatory deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Production failures are escalated the same day rather than left in a batch queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice period counted in the correct unit for the state and from the correct trigger date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin notice production log and the mailing evidence stored in the DMS.

steps.title: Read the trigger date and state notice period for each notice
sop: Identify the trigger event and its date on the policy admin transaction.
Look up the notice period and unit for the risk state.
Record both against the notice production record.
Done when trigger date and state notice period are recorded.
verify: Re-derive the notice period from the state requirements matrix.
Pass when the recorded period matches the matrix.

steps.title: Count the notice period in the correct unit for the state
sop: Determine whether the state counts calendar days or business days.
Compute the latest permissible mailing date on that basis.
Flag any notice where the computation is already breached.
Done when every notice has a computed latest mailing date.
verify: Recompute three latest mailing dates independently.
Pass when the recomputed dates match the recorded dates.

steps.title: Back the mailing date off the effective date to allow transit
sop: Subtract the transit allowance from the latest permissible mailing date.
Schedule production so the notice drops on or before that date.
Reschedule any notice that cannot make the window.
Done when production is scheduled inside the statutory window.
verify: Compare scheduled drop dates to the computed latest mailing dates.
Pass when every scheduled drop precedes its latest mailing date.

steps.title: Confirm state reason wording and rights language on the notice
sop: Render each cancellation, nonrenewal and adverse-action notice.
Confirm the state-required reason wording is present and specific.
Confirm appeal and rights language appears in full.
Done when the required wording is confirmed on every notice type.
verify: Re-read the rendered notices against the state wording checklist.
Pass when every required statement is present.

steps.title: Escalate production failures the same day
sop: Monitor the notice production job for held or errored notices.
Escalate any statutory notice held by a failure the same day.
Track the escalation until the notice is produced and mailed.
Done when no statutory notice sits held overnight.
verify: Read the held notice queue at end of day.
Pass when no statutory notice remains held overnight.

steps.title: Log late notices as exceptions and decide on re-noticing
sop: Compare actual mailing dates to the computed statutory deadlines.
Log every late notice as an exception with the days late.
Adjust the transaction date or re-notice where the state requires it.
Done when every late notice has a logged exception and a decision.
verify: Read the exception log against the late notice list.
Pass when every late notice carries a logged decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: All DOI inquiries, market conduct requests, examination notices and subpoenas arriving in any channel.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day, from mail open to compliance queue delivery.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, regulator, channel, postmark where retained and compliance queue reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Regulator items scanned equal regulator items identified at mail open.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Imaged letter and envelope stored with the receipt timestamp in the DMS.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items found later in a general queue are logged as misroutes with the correction recorded.
generic.Test population: All regulator correspondence received during the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No regulator item is sitting in a general operations work queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Acknowledgement is sent to the regulator where the correspondence requests one.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Item scanned and delivered to the compliance intake queue the same business day.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance intake queue in the workflow tool and the imaged item in the DMS.

steps.title: Identify regulator items at the mail-open step
sop: Watch for DOI, market conduct, examination and subpoena items while opening mail.
Pull them out of the general batch immediately on sight.
Check the shared intake mailbox in Microsoft 365 for the same categories.
Done when all regulator items are separated from general mail.
verify: Spot-check general batches for a regulator item.
Pass when no regulator item is found in a general batch.

steps.title: Retain and image the envelope where the postmark starts the clock
sop: Keep the envelope with every regulator item.
Image the envelope and link it to the document record in the DMS.
Key the postmark date onto the document profile.
Done when every regulator item has an imaged envelope and postmark.
verify: Query regulator items with no envelope image.
Pass when no regulator item lacks its envelope image.

steps.title: Scan and deliver to the compliance intake queue same day
sop: Scan the regulator item into the document management repository on receipt.
Route it to the compliance intake queue in the workflow tool the same day.
Escalate any item that cannot be delivered the same day.
Done when every item is in the compliance queue on its receipt day.
verify: Compare receipt dates to compliance queue delivery dates.
Pass when delivery date equals receipt date for every item.

steps.title: Secure the original hard copy in the compliance file
sop: Place the original regulator letter in the secure compliance file.
Do not return the original to general storage or the quarantine bin.
Record the physical file location against the document record.
Done when every original is secured in the compliance file.
verify: Trace three logged items to their physical compliance file location.
Pass when every traced original is in the compliance file.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt to the regulator where requested
sop: Read each item for a request to acknowledge receipt.
Send the acknowledgement through the regulator's stated channel.
Record the acknowledgement date and reference against the item.
Done when every acknowledgement-requesting item is acknowledged.
verify: Match acknowledgement records to items requesting acknowledgement.
Pass when every such item carries an acknowledgement record.

steps.title: Sweep general operations queues for misrouted regulator items
sop: Search the general operations work queues for regulator sender names.
Move any found item into the compliance intake queue immediately.
Log the misroute with its cause for intake feedback.
Done when no regulator item remains in a general queue.
verify: Re-run the queue search after the sweep.
Pass when the search returns no regulator items.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open regulatory correspondence items plus responses closed in the reporting period.
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting cadence period with a prior-period comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Regulator, state, topic, owner, days remaining and on-time response outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported open item count equals open items in the correspondence log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version stored with the extract date and reporting period.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late responses are listed with their cause and the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: All open and closed correspondence items for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Current inventory report lists open correspondence with owner and days to deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Items inside the escalation window are called out at the top of the report.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: On-time response rate reported against target with reasons for every miss.
generic.Evidence location: Correspondence log extract and the report stored in SharePoint and the DMS.

steps.title: Extract open correspondence items from the log in the DMS
sop: Run the open correspondence extract for the reporting period.
Include regulator, state, topic, owner and response deadline per row.
Compute days remaining to deadline for each row.
Done when the open item extract is complete.
verify: Reconcile extract row count to open items in the correspondence log.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Call out items inside the escalation window at the top
sop: Filter for items with days remaining below the escalation threshold.
Place that list at the top of the report with owner names.
Note the current status of each escalated item.
Done when the escalation section is complete.
verify: Check the escalation section against the days-remaining column.
Pass when every item under the threshold appears in the section.

steps.title: Report the on-time response rate against target
sop: Compute responses filed on time divided by responses filed in the period.
Compare the rate against the published target.
State the cause for every late response.
Done when the on-time rate and late reasons are reported.
verify: Recompute the rate from the closed item list.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Trend recurring subject matter across inquiries
sop: Group inquiries in the period by topic and product line.
Identify topics recurring above the review threshold.
Flag possible systemic issues for root-cause review.
Done when recurring topics are identified and flagged.
verify: Re-run the grouping over the prior two periods.
Pass when flagged topics are consistent with the trend data.

steps.title: Add the prior-period comparison to the report
sop: Place prior-period open volume and on-time rate alongside the current figures.
Write commentary explaining any material movement.
Confirm prior figures match what was previously published.

steps.title: Deliver the report to the compliance officer on cadence

Deliver it to the compliance officer on the published cadence.
Store the delivered version in the DMS with its delivery date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every regulatory submission filed in the period and its complete exhibit set as filed.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions without a confirmation reference are chased and logged until evidenced.
generic.Test population: All regulatory submissions filed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No regulatory submission record is eligible for purge before its retention period.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing confirmations are chased with the regulator and the chase is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exact submitted set archived, including all exhibits as filed, with a confirmation reference.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText correspondence file indexed by regulator, reference number and year.

steps.title: Collect the submission confirmation evidence
sop: Capture the portal receipt, filing acknowledgement number or certified-mail receipt.
File it against the correspondence record in the DMS.
Chase the regulator where no confirmation was issued.
Done when every submission has a confirmation reference filed.
verify: Query submissions with no confirmation reference.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Archive the exact submitted document set with all exhibits
sop: Take the package exactly as submitted rather than a later working copy.
Archive the response and every exhibit in the filed order into OpenText.
Count archived exhibits against the exhibit list in the response.
Done when the full submitted set is archived.
verify: Compare archived exhibit count to the exhibit list in the response.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Preserve the submission date-and-time stamp as deadline evidence

Store it on the correspondence record alongside the statutory deadline.
Confirm the timestamp evidences the deadline was met.
Done when the timestamp is stored against the record.
verify: Compare the stored timestamp to the statutory deadline on the record.
Pass when the timestamp precedes the deadline or an extension is filed.

steps.title: Apply the regulatory submission retention class in OpenText
sop: Set the retention class for regulatory submissions on the archived record.
Confirm the class prevents early purge under the disposition job.
Escalate any record defaulting to a shorter class.
Done when the correct retention class is applied.
verify: Run the disposition eligibility check against the archived records.
Pass when no record is eligible before its regulatory retention period.

steps.title: Index the correspondence file by regulator, reference and year
sop: Key regulator, reference number and year onto the correspondence file index.
Confirm the index supports retrieval during an examination.
Correct any file indexed without a reference number.
Done when every correspondence file carries the three index values.
verify: Search by regulator and reference number for a sample of files.
Pass when every sampled file retrieves on the first search.

steps.title: Reconcile archived submissions to the correspondence log
sop: Extract submissions filed in the period from the correspondence log.
Match each to an archived record with a confirmation reference.
Chase and archive any submission with no archived record.
Done when every filed submission has an archived record.
verify: Re-run the match after remediation.
Pass when every filed submission matches an archived record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All logged regulator items requiring assignment to a business unit and a compliance lead.
generic.In-scope period: Current business day, from log entry creation to assignee acknowledgement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Business unit, compliance lead, response deadline, internal draft-due date and acknowledgement.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned items equal logged regulator items open in the period.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reassignments are logged with a reason so the ownership trail survives.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open regulator item is unassigned or unacknowledged past one business day.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-acknowledgement is chased before the item ages one business day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A compliance lead is assigned on every regulator item in parallel with the business unit.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow tool assignment history and the correspondence record in the DMS.

steps.title: Identify the responsible business unit from the subject matter
sop: Read the regulator item for its subject matter and any named policy or claim.
Map it to underwriting, claims, billing or privacy using the routing guide.
Record the business unit on the correspondence record.
Done when every item has a business unit assigned.
verify: Sample five items and re-derive the business unit from the subject matter.
Pass when every sampled assignment matches the routing guide.

steps.title: Assign a compliance lead in parallel on every regulator item
sop: Assign a named compliance or legal lead on every regulator item.
Do not wait for the business unit to escalate before assigning.
Record the lead on the correspondence record in the workflow tool.
Done when every item carries a compliance lead.
verify: Query open regulator items with no compliance lead.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Carry the response deadline and draft-due date onto the assignment
sop: Copy the statutory response deadline onto the assignment.
Set an internal draft-due date ahead of the response deadline.
Ensure both dates are visible to the assignee in the workflow tool.
Done when every assignment shows both dates.
verify: Read the assignment records for a missing draft-due date.
Pass when every assignment carries both dates.

steps.title: Require and chase assignee acknowledgement
sop: Require the assignee to acknowledge receipt in the workflow tool.
Chase any unacknowledged item before it ages one business day.
Escalate to the compliance lead where the chase fails.
Done when every assignment is acknowledged or escalated.
verify: Read open items for acknowledgements older than one business day.
Pass when no open item is unacknowledged past one business day.

steps.title: Log every reassignment with its reason
sop: Capture the reason whenever an item moves between assignees.
Record the previous and new assignee on the assignment history.
Preserve the full ownership trail for the examination file.
Done when every reassignment carries a logged reason.
verify: Read the assignment history for reassignments with no reason.
Pass when every reassignment has a reason.

steps.title: Publish the assignment position to the compliance team in SharePoint
sop: Extract the current assignment and acknowledgement position from the workflow tool.
Publish it to the compliance team workspace in SharePoint.
Highlight unassigned and unacknowledged items for immediate action.
Done when the current position is published.
verify: Compare the published list against the workflow tool assignments.
Pass when the published list matches the workflow position.

generic.Defined scope/population: All approved regulatory responses due for filing within their statutory deadline.
generic.In-scope period: From final approval to confirmed submission with the regulator.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Regulator channel, submitted version, exhibit list, submission timestamp and confirmation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibits submitted equal exhibits cited in the approved response.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Extension requests are recorded with the written grant before the deadline passes.

generic.Evidence location: Regulator portal receipt and the correspondence record in the DMS.

steps.title: Confirm the regulator's required submission channel
sop: Read the regulator letter and the state filing guide for the required channel.
Confirm whether portal, secure email or physical filing is mandated.
Do not substitute a more convenient channel.
Done when the required channel is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Compare the channel used to the regulator's stated requirement.
Pass when the channel used matches the requirement.

steps.title: Verify the filing candidate against the approval record
sop: Read the approved version and approval date from the approval record.
Compare the filing candidate document version and date.
Return for re-approval where the versions differ.
Done when the filing candidate equals the approved version.
verify: Compare version identifiers on the approval and filing records.
Pass when the two identifiers are identical.

steps.title: Attach and open-test every cited exhibit in the package
sop: Attach every exhibit cited in the response to the submission package.
Open each attached exhibit from the package to confirm it renders.
Replace any corrupted or unopenable exhibit before submission.
Done when every cited exhibit is attached and opens.
verify: Re-open the exhibits from the assembled package.
Pass when every exhibit opens successfully.

steps.title: Submit with buffer ahead of the statutory deadline
sop: Schedule the submission with buffer time before the statutory deadline.
Allow for portal outages and channel failures in the buffer.
Escalate immediately if the channel is unavailable inside the buffer.
Done when the submission completes inside the buffer window.
verify: Compare the submission timestamp to the statutory deadline.
Pass when the submission precedes the deadline.

steps.title: Request and confirm an extension in writing where needed
sop: Identify responses that cannot be completed within the deadline.
Request an extension in writing before the deadline passes.
File the written grant against the correspondence record in the DMS.
Done when every extension is requested and granted in writing.
verify: Read late filings for a filed written extension grant.
Pass when every late filing carries a granted extension.

steps.title: Capture the submission confirmation and close the log entry
sop: Capture the portal receipt or acknowledgement number from the regulator.
Store it on the correspondence record in the DMS with the timestamp.
Close the correspondence log entry with the submission outcome.
Done when the log entry is closed with a confirmation reference.
verify: Read closed log entries for a missing confirmation reference.
Pass when every closed entry carries a confirmation reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every outbound notice type in production use across all states written.
generic.In-scope period: Current verification cycle plus any state changes issued since the last cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice type, state, notice period, delivery method, mandatory language and statute citation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix entries cover every outbound notice type and state combination in use.

generic.Exception handling path: State requirement changes are routed into the template and rules change queue with a target date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Font size, placement and prominence checked on the rendered notice, not just the template.
generic.Evidence location: State requirements matrix in the DMS and the rendered notices in the policy admin system.

steps.title: List outbound notice types in production use

Cross-check against notices actually produced in the last period.
Record the state coverage for each notice type.
Done when the in-use notice type and state list is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the notice production extract.
Pass when every produced notice type appears on the list.

steps.title: Confirm notice period, delivery method and language per state
sop: For each notice type and state read the required period and delivery method.
