Record all three on the state requirements matrix in the DMS.
Done when every combination has a matrix entry.
verify: Sample six combinations against the statute or bulletin cited.
Pass when every sampled entry matches its cited source.

steps.title: Identify states requiring certified or proof-of-mailing delivery
sop: Flag matrix entries where certified or proof-of-mailing delivery is mandated.
Confirm the mail class configuration in the policy admin system matches.
Raise a change where the configured class is wrong.
Done when certified delivery states are flagged and configuration checked.
verify: Compare flagged states to the configured mail class per notice type.
Pass when configuration matches the flagged requirement.

steps.title: Check prominence requirements on the rendered notice
sop: Render each notice type for a state with prominence requirements.
Check font size, placement and prominence on the rendered output.
Do not rely on the template definition alone.
Done when prominence is verified on rendered notices.
verify: Measure font size and placement on the rendered samples.
Pass when every sample meets the state prominence requirement.

steps.title: Date and source every matrix entry to its statute or bulletin
sop: Record the statute or bulletin citation on every matrix entry.
Record the verification date on the entry.
Mark entries without a citation as unverified.
Done when every entry carries a citation and verification date.
verify: Read the matrix for entries with no citation.
Pass when no entry lacks a citation.

steps.title: Route requirement changes into the template and rules change queue
sop: List matrix entries changed since the last verification cycle.
Raise a change request for each affected template or rule.
Set a target implementation date ahead of the regulatory effective date.
Done when every change is queued with a target date.
verify: Compare changed matrix entries to raised change requests.
Pass when every change has a queued request with a target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every record created by a producing system or ingested at intake into the repository today.

steps.title: Auto-derive the retention code at save time in OpenText

Record the mapping version applied on the classification event.

sop: Select the trigger from creation date, policy expiry, claim closure or relationship end.

Hold records where the trigger cannot be determined.
Done when every record carries a retention trigger type.

Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Restrict manual overrides to records-management roles
sop: Confirm the override function is limited to records-management roles in OpenText.
Require a justification on every override submitted.
Review overrides made in the day for validity.
Done when all overrides carry a justification from an authorised role.
verify: Read the override log for entries from unauthorised roles or with no justification.
Pass when no such override entry exists.

steps.title: Work the daily unclassified-record exception report to zero
sop: Run the unclassified-record exception report in the DMS.
Classify or route each listed record for schedule mapping.
Raise a schedule change where a document type has no mapping.
Done when the exception report is worked to zero.
verify: Re-run the exception report after working the list.
Pass when the re-run report is empty.

steps.title: Sample-test classified records against the retention schedule
sop: Draw a sample of records classified during the day.
Re-derive the expected retention code from the published schedule.
Log any mismatch as a classification defect with the record id.
Done when the sample is tested and defects are logged.
verify: Compare sampled codes against the re-derived codes.
Pass when every sampled code matches the schedule.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full document repository population plus all privileged and records-admin accounts.
generic.In-scope period: Current audit year, from audit scoping to findings closure tracking.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Finding id, owner, remediation action, due date and closure evidence.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled populations reconcile to repository record counts by retention class.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every finding carries an owner, action and due date tracked to closure.
generic.Test population: Sampled records by retention class plus the full privileged account list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior-year audit finding remains open past its remediation due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Orphaned records are re-linked or dispositioned rather than left unowned.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit covers orphaned records, retention misclassification and access controls.
generic.Evidence location: Audit report and findings tracker stored in the DMS audit folder.

steps.title: Scope the annual audit and draw the sample
sop: Define the audit scope covering orphans, retention classes and access controls.
Draw samples by retention class sized to the sampling standard.
Record the scope and sample basis in the audit workpapers.
Done when scope and samples are defined and recorded.
verify: Compare the sample sizes to the sampling standard.
Pass when every sample meets the standard.

steps.title: Identify orphaned records with no linked policy, claim or party
sop: Query OpenText for records with no linked policy, claim or party.
Re-link records where the parent can be identified.
Disposition the remainder through the approval route.
Done when every orphan is re-linked or dispositioned.
verify: Re-run the orphan query after remediation.
Pass when the orphan count falls to the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Re-test sampled retention classes against the current schedule
sop: Re-derive the expected retention class for each sampled record.
Compare against the class stored in the repository.
Log misclassifications with record id and both classes.
Done when the sample is fully re-tested.
verify: Recompute the misclassification rate from the sample results.
Pass when the computed rate matches the reported finding.

steps.title: Recertify privileged and records-admin access in the DMS
sop: Extract the privileged and records-admin account list from the repository.
Recertify each account with its owning manager.
Remove leavers and eliminate shared accounts.
Done when every privileged account is recertified or removed.
verify: Compare the post-recertification account list to the staff roster.
Pass when no leaver or shared account remains.

steps.title: Quantify records past disposition date but still stored
sop: Query records whose disposition date has passed but which remain stored.
Split the population between legal-hold driven and genuine backlog.
Report the quantified aged-disposition finding.
Done when the over-retained population is quantified and split.
verify: Reconcile the split populations to the total over-retained count.
Pass when the split sums to the total.

steps.title: Log findings with owners and track them to closure
sop: Log every finding with owner, remediation action and due date.
Issue the audit report with scope, findings and owners.
Track findings to evidenced closure rather than closing at report issue.
Done when the report is issued and findings are in the tracker.
verify: Read the tracker for findings open past their due date.
Pass when no prior-year finding is open past its due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved destruction list of physical and digital records due for disposal.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Digital purge removes images, index metadata, backups and downstream copies.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText destruction log and the certified shredding vendor manifest.

steps.title: Re-run the legal-hold check immediately before execution
sop: Re-check every record on the approved list against the hold register.
Pull any record with a hold placed after approval.
Log each pulled record with the hold reference.
Done when the run list is clear of held records.

Pass when no held record appears on the executed list.

steps.title: Execute the certified shredding pickup under chain of custody
sop: Release the physical records to the certified shredding vendor.
Confirm the contracted secure chain of custody is followed at pickup.
Record the pickup manifest reference against the run.
Done when the physical records are collected under manifest.
verify: Match the manifest quantities to the physical records released.
Pass when manifest and released quantities agree.

steps.title: Execute the digital purge across all copies in OpenText
sop: Run the purge so images, index metadata and downstream copies are removed.

Confirm no residual pointer remains in the repository index.
Done when the purge job completes across all copy locations.
verify: Search the repository and index for purged record ids.
Pass when no purged id resolves anywhere in the repository.

steps.title: Re-verify the executed list against the approved list item for item
sop: Extract the executed destruction list after the run.
Compare item for item against the approved list version.
Investigate any item destroyed that was not on the approved list.
Done when executed and approved lists reconcile.
verify: Recompute the comparison after investigation.
Pass when the executed list matches the approved list.

steps.title: Write the destruction event to the immutable destruction log
sop: Create the destruction log entry with date, method, approver and record count.
Confirm the log entry cannot be edited after commit.
Attach the vendor manifest or purge job reference to the entry.
Done when the log entry is committed with all fields.
verify: Attempt to edit a committed destruction log entry.
Pass when the edit is rejected and all fields are present.

steps.title: Review the completed run with compliance before closure
sop: Review the executed list, hold re-check evidence and destruction log.
Confirm no held record was destroyed and all counts reconcile.
Sign off the run as closed in the records-management file.
Done when the run is reviewed and signed off.
verify: Read the closed run file for the sign-off and supporting evidence.
Pass when the run carries a compliance sign-off with evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: All records flagged under the matter that counsel has formally released.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records under a second live hold stay flagged with that matter recorded.

steps.title: File the written release instruction against the hold record
sop: Obtain the written release instruction from counsel.
File it against the hold record in the document management repository.
Refuse to clear any flag without the written instruction on file.
Done when the release instruction is filed.
verify: Open the hold record and read the filed instruction.
Pass when the release instruction is present and signed by counsel.

steps.title: Re-confirm the hold scope before clearing flags
sop: List the records flagged under the released matter.
Check each for flags belonging to other live matters.
Exclude multi-hold records from the clearing set.
Done when the clearing set contains only single-matter records.
verify: Cross-check the clearing set against all open matters.
Pass when no record in the set is held under another matter.

steps.title: Clear the hold flag across every repository the hold touched
sop: Clear the flag in OpenText and the document management repository.
Clear it in the policy admin system, mailboxes and file shares in Microsoft 365.
Record each repository cleared against the hold record.
Done when all touched repositories are cleared.
verify: Query each repository for records still flagged under the matter.
Pass when no repository returns a flagged record.

steps.title: Issue written release notices to previously notified custodians
sop: List custodians who received the original hold notice.
Send each a written release notice from Microsoft 365.
Record the notice date against the custodian on the hold record.
Done when every custodian has a recorded release notice.
verify: Compare release notices sent to the original custodian list.
Pass when every original custodian received a release notice.

steps.title: Record the release detail on the hold register
sop: Record release date, releasing counsel and matter reference on the register.
Set the hold status to Released.
Retain the closed entry for the audit trail rather than deleting it.
Done when the register entry shows the full release detail.
verify: Read the register entry for blank release fields.
Pass when release date, counsel and matter are all populated.

steps.title: Hand the released records to normal retention handling
sop: Notify records management that the released set is ready for normal handling.
List records already past their disposition date while held.
Pass both lists to the retention restoration process.
Done when the released set is handed over with the over-retained list.
verify: Confirm receipt of the handover in the records-management log.
Pass when the handover is acknowledged with both lists attached.

Chase the vendor where the certificate is not received on time.

Link the certificate to the destroyed record inventory list.

Confirm the counts match the approved digital destruction list.

verify: Compare purge log record counts to the approved list counts.

steps.title: Index certificates by destruction date and retention category
sop: Key destruction date and retention category onto each filed certificate.

Correct any certificate filed without index values.

verify: Search certificates by destruction date and retention category.

Escalate repeat vendor failures to contract management.

sop: Extract destruction events from the immutable destruction log.
Match each to a filed certificate or purge log.
Chase any unmatched event to closure.
Done when every destruction event maps to evidence.
verify: Re-run the match after chasing.

steps.title: State the retention period per document type per state
sop: Record the retention period required by each state for each document type.
Take the longest applicable period where jurisdictions differ.
Record the driving state alongside the selected period.
Done when every type has a state-tested retention period.
verify: Sample six rows and re-derive the longest applicable period.
Pass when every sampled period matches the re-derivation.

steps.title: Cite the statutory source for every retention period
sop: Record the statute or regulation citation supporting each period.
Mark rows with no citation as unverified.
Resolve unverified rows before the schedule is published.
Done when every row carries a citation.
verify: Read the schedule for rows with no citation.
Pass when no row lacks a citation.

steps.title: Define the retention trigger explicitly per document type
sop: Select the trigger from creation, policy expiry, claim closure or relationship end.
Record it explicitly on each schedule row.
Avoid leaving the trigger implied by the document type.
Done when every row names its retention trigger.
verify: Read the schedule for rows with a blank trigger.
Pass when every row names a trigger.

steps.title: Route schedule changes through records-management and legal approval
sop: Package the proposed changes for records-management and legal review.
Obtain approval before the DMS mapping table is updated.
Record the approval date on the schedule version.
Done when the changes are approved and dated.
verify: Compare the live mapping table version to the approved schedule version.
Pass when the live version matches the approved version.

steps.title: Publish the schedule and archive the superseded version
sop: Publish the approved schedule version in SharePoint with its effective date.
Archive the superseded version with its effective date range.
Confirm historic dispositions can still be justified against the archived version.
Done when the new version is published and the old one archived.
verify: Open the archive and read the superseded version effective dates.
Pass when every superseded version has an effective date range.

generic.Defined scope/population: All records in the repository across active, inactive, pending disposition, on hold and destroyed stages.
generic.In-scope period: Current monitoring cycle with storage growth trended against prior cycles.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lifecycle stage, disposition date, retention class and trigger date on every record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Lifecycle dashboard stage counts reconcile to the repository total record count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard snapshot retained with the refresh timestamp for the cycle.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records past disposition date but still active are logged as lifecycle exceptions.
generic.Test population: All records held in the repository at the monitoring date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No record past its disposition date is absent from the disposition review queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Records whose trigger never fired are raised as data-quality fixes with an owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dashboard shows counts by stage reconciling to the repository total.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText lifecycle dashboard and the retained monitoring snapshot in the DMS.

steps.title: Refresh the lifecycle dashboard stage counts in OpenText
sop: Refresh counts for active, inactive, pending disposition, on hold and destroyed.
Record the refresh timestamp on the monitoring snapshot.
Investigate any stage that failed to refresh.
Done when all five stage counts are current.
verify: Sum the stage counts and compare to the repository total.
Pass when the stage counts sum to the repository total.

steps.title: Age records past disposition date that remain active
sop: Query records whose disposition date has passed but stage is still active.
Age the population into buckets by days over.
Report the result as a lifecycle exception.
Done when the over-retained population is aged and reported.
verify: Compare the exception population to the disposition review queue.
Pass when every over-retained record appears in the review queue.

steps.title: Trend storage growth by retention class
sop: Extract storage volume by retention class for the cycle.
Compare against prior cycles to identify classes that never disposition.
Flag classes with continuous growth for schedule review.
Done when the growth trend is produced and classes flagged.
verify: Recompute the growth figures from the prior cycle snapshots.
Pass when the trend figures reconcile across cycles.

steps.title: Identify records whose retention trigger never fired
sop: Query records with a trigger type but no trigger date populated.
Investigate causes such as claims never closed in the source system.
Raise data-quality fixes with a named owner for each cause.
Done when every never-fired trigger has a raised fix.
verify: Read the data-quality log against the never-fired population.
Pass when every cause has a raised fix with an owner.

steps.title: Reconcile the lifecycle dashboard to repository counts
sop: Compare each stage count to the underlying repository query.
Investigate any record unaccounted for between stages.
Correct stage assignment where a record is in no stage.
Done when every record maps to exactly one stage.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after correction.
Pass when no record is unaccounted for between stages.

steps.title: Publish the lifecycle monitoring snapshot for the cycle
sop: Assemble stage counts, aged exceptions and growth trend into the snapshot.
Store the snapshot in the DMS with its refresh timestamp.
Circulate exceptions to their owners for action.
Done when the snapshot is stored and exceptions circulated.
verify: Open the stored snapshot and confirm all three sections are present.
Pass when the snapshot contains counts, exceptions and trend.

generic.Defined scope/population: The disposition list of records eligible for destruction at retention end in this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current disposition cycle, from list circulation to signed approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Record types, counts, date ranges, approver name, authority level and list version.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved counts by record type match the disposition list version approved.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval stored with the disposition list version and approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items challenged in review are pulled from the list with the challenge recorded.
generic.Test population: All disposition lists approved in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No destruction is executed against a list version that was not approved.
generic.Exception handling path: A challenge pulls the item rather than delaying the entire list.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Legal-hold and pending-litigation clearance confirmed in writing by counsel.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint approval record and the disposition list version stored in the DMS.

steps.title: Circulate the disposition list to records owner, legal and compliance
sop: Assemble the disposition list showing record types, counts and date ranges.
Circulate it in SharePoint to the records owner, legal and compliance.
Set a response deadline so the list does not sit unactioned.
Done when the list is circulated with a deadline.
verify: Read the circulation record for named recipients and a deadline.
Pass when all three parties received the list with a deadline.

steps.title: Obtain written legal-hold and litigation clearance from counsel
sop: Ask counsel to confirm no hold or pending litigation touches the list.
Obtain that clearance in writing as part of the approval.
Hold the list where clearance is not given in writing.
Done when written clearance is on file.
verify: Open the approval pack and read the counsel clearance.
Pass when a written clearance from counsel is present.

steps.title: Confirm the approver holds the required authority level
sop: Read the record class on the disposition list.
Check the approver's authority level against the authority matrix.
Reject approvals from an approver below the required level.
Done when the approver's authority is confirmed.
verify: Match the approver against the current authority register.
Pass when the approver holds the required level.

steps.title: Pull challenged items rather than delaying the whole list
sop: Collect challenges raised during the review window.
Remove each challenged item from the list and record the challenge.
Re-issue the list version without the challenged items.
Done when challenged items are removed and the list re-versioned.
verify: Compare the approved list to the challenge log.
Pass when no challenged item remains on the approved list.

steps.title: Store the signed approval with the approved list version
sop: Capture the signed approval in SharePoint with the approval date.
Store the exact disposition list version approved alongside it.
Confirm the executed list can be matched back to this version.
Done when approval and list version are stored together.
verify: Open the approval and read the referenced list version.
Pass when the approval names a specific list version and counts.

steps.title: Release the approved list to the destruction execution queue
sop: Release only the approved list version to the execution queue in the DMS.
Lock the list so no item can be added after approval.
Notify the execution owner that the approved list is ready.
Done when the approved list is released and locked.
verify: Compare the queued list contents to the approved version.
Pass when the queued list matches the approved version exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: All records matching counsel's hold criteria across the DMS, admin system and mailboxes.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of counsel's hold instruction to custodian acknowledgement completion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Matter reference, issuing counsel, hold scope, effective date and custodian list.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quarantined record count equals records returned by the agreed hold search criteria.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hold register entry with scope, counsel, effective date and search criteria version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records that cannot be quarantined are escalated with the technical reason.
generic.Test population: All records in the hold scope.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-scope record remains subject to automated disposition after the hold is applied.
generic.Exception handling path: Custodian non-acknowledgement is chased and escalated to counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Auto-disposition suspended before any other step so nothing purges during the search.
generic.Evidence location: Hold register in the DMS plus custodian notices tracked in Microsoft 365.

steps.title: Translate counsel's instruction into concrete search criteria
sop: Read the hold instruction for parties, policy or claim numbers, dates and document types.
Write concrete search criteria covering each element.
Confirm the criteria with counsel before running the search.
Done when counsel has confirmed the search criteria.
verify: Compare the criteria against the instruction element by element.
Pass when every element of the instruction is covered.

steps.title: Suspend auto-disposition on in-scope records before searching
sop: Apply the disposition suspension across the candidate population first.
Confirm the disposition job will skip suspended records.
Only then proceed to the detailed search and quarantine.
Done when auto-disposition is suspended across the candidate set.
verify: Run the disposition eligibility check across the in-scope records.
Pass when no in-scope record is eligible for disposition.

steps.title: Run the hold search across the DMS, admin system and mailboxes
sop: Run the confirmed criteria in OpenText and the document management repository.
Repeat in the policy admin system and the relevant Microsoft 365 mailboxes.
Record the result counts per source against the hold record.
Done when all three sources have been searched.
verify: Read the hold record for per-source result counts.
Pass when every source shows a recorded result count.

steps.title: Quarantine or flag in-scope records read-only
sop: Apply the quarantine or read-only flag to every in-scope record.
Confirm business users can still read but not alter the records.
Escalate any record that cannot be flagged with the technical reason.
Done when every in-scope record is quarantined or escalated.
verify: Attempt an edit on a sample of quarantined records.
Pass when the edit is rejected on every sampled record.

steps.title: Issue custodian hold notices and track acknowledgements
sop: Send hold notices to every identified custodian from Microsoft 365.
Track acknowledgements against the custodian list.
Chase non-acknowledgement and escalate to counsel where it persists.
Done when every custodian has acknowledged or been escalated.
verify: Compare acknowledgements received to the custodian list.
Pass when every custodian has acknowledged or is escalated.

steps.title: Create the hold register entry in the DMS
sop: Create the register entry with matter reference, issuing counsel and scope.
Record the effective date and the search criteria version used.
Link the custodian list and acknowledgements to the entry.
Done when the register entry is complete.
verify: Read the register entry for blank required fields.
Pass when matter, counsel, scope and effective date are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open legal holds on the register plus holds applied or released since the last report.
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting cadence period with movements since the prior report.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Matter reference, issue date, scope, custodian count and record volume held.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported held record volumes reconcile to quarantined counts in the repository.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version stored with the extract date and reporting period.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Custodian acknowledgement gaps are listed by name for counsel to chase.
generic.Test population: All open holds on the register at the report date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report lists all open holds with scope, age and acknowledgement status.
generic.Exception handling path: Holds open beyond the defined age are flagged to counsel to confirm necessity.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Newly applied and newly released holds shown as movements since the prior report.
generic.Evidence location: Hold register extract in the DMS and the report stored in SharePoint.

steps.title: Extract all open holds from the register in the DMS
sop: Run the open hold extract from the hold register for the report date.
Include matter reference, issue date, scope and custodian count per hold.
Add the record volume currently held under each matter.
Done when the open hold extract is complete.
verify: Reconcile extracted held volumes to quarantined record counts.
Pass when the volumes reconcile.

steps.title: Flag holds open beyond the defined age threshold
sop: Compute the age of each open hold from its issue date.
Flag holds exceeding the defined age threshold.
Ask counsel to confirm continued necessity for each flagged hold.
Done when every aged hold is flagged for counsel confirmation.
verify: Compare flagged holds to the age threshold.
Pass when every hold over the threshold is flagged.

steps.title: List custodian acknowledgement gaps by name
sop: Compare custodian lists against acknowledgements received per matter.
List unacknowledged custodians by name and matter.
Include the days outstanding for each gap.
Done when the acknowledgement gap list is complete.
verify: Recompute the gaps from the acknowledgement records.
Pass when the listed gaps match the acknowledgement records.

steps.title: Show holds applied and released since the prior report
sop: Extract holds created and released since the prior report date.
Present them as movements with matter reference and date.
Reconcile opening plus applied less released to the closing count.
Done when the movement section reconciles.
verify: Recompute opening plus movements against the closing hold count.
Pass when the movement reconciliation balances.

steps.title: Assemble the hold inventory report in SharePoint
sop: Assemble open holds, aged flags, acknowledgement gaps and movements.
Store the report in the SharePoint legal-hold workspace.
Record the extract date and report version on the document.
Done when the report is assembled and stored.
verify: Open the stored report and confirm all four sections are present.
Pass when every section is present and populated.

steps.title: Deliver to counsel and compliance with a review confirmation request
sop: Deliver the report to legal counsel and compliance on the published cadence.
Request written confirmation that the inventory has been reviewed.
Record confirmations received against the report version.
Done when the report is delivered and confirmations requested.
verify: Read the delivery record for recipients and confirmation status.
Pass when both counsel and compliance received the report.

generic.Defined scope/population: Retention classification accuracy, outstanding disposition approvals and open audit findings.
generic.In-scope period: Current committee reporting period with prior-period carry-forward actions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Classification accuracy, sampling basis, pending approval ages and finding due dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Over-retained volumes reconcile between the hold-driven and backlog splits.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee pack version stored with the reporting period and issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Committee decisions are minuted with owner and due date and carried forward.
generic.Test population: Sampled records for classification accuracy plus all open approvals and findings.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Committee pack exists for the period with accuracy, approvals and findings sections.
generic.Exception handling path: Legal-hold driven over-retention is separated from genuine disposition backlog.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Classification accuracy reported with the sampling basis stated.
generic.Evidence location: Committee pack in SharePoint and the supporting extracts held in the DMS.

steps.title: Compute classification accuracy with the sampling basis stated
sop: Draw a sample of records by retention class from the repository.
Re-derive the expected class and compute the accuracy percentage.
State the sample size and selection basis alongside the figure.
Done when accuracy is computed with its sampling basis.
verify: Recompute the accuracy from the sample results.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the reported figure.

steps.title: List outstanding disposition approvals by age
sop: Extract disposition lists awaiting approval from the DMS.
Compute the age of each pending approval.
Show how long the underlying records have been over-retained.
Done when the pending approval list is aged.
verify: Recompute the ages from the circulation dates.
Pass when the ages match the circulation dates.

steps.title: Report open audit findings against their due dates
sop: Extract open findings from the records-management findings tracker.
Show remediation status and days to or past the due date.
Highlight findings already past due for committee attention.
Done when the findings section is complete.
verify: Compare the section to the findings tracker.
Pass when every open finding appears with its due date.

steps.title: Separate hold-driven over-retention from genuine backlog
sop: Split the over-retained population by whether a legal hold applies.
Report the hold-driven volume separately from the backlog volume.
Confirm the two volumes sum to the total over-retained population.
Done when the split is reported and reconciles.
verify: Sum the two volumes against the total over-retained count.
Pass when the split sums to the total.

steps.title: Assemble the committee pack in SharePoint
sop: Assemble accuracy, pending approvals, findings and over-retention sections.
Include prior-period actions and their current status.
Store the pack in the SharePoint records-committee workspace.
Done when the pack is assembled and stored.
verify: Open the stored pack and check all sections are present.
Pass when every required section is present.

steps.title: Minute committee decisions with owner and due date
sop: Record each committee decision and assigned action in the minutes.
Name an owner and a due date for every action.
Carry open actions into the next reporting period pack.
Done when all decisions are minuted with owners and dates.
verify: Read the minutes for actions with no owner or due date.
Pass when every action carries an owner and a due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All records released from a legal hold and returning to standard retention handling.
generic.In-scope period: From hold release confirmation to disposition re-enablement and access restoration.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original trigger date, recalculated retention expiry, hold release date and restoration event.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Records restored equal records released under the closed matter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Restoration event logged per record with the timestamp and releasing matter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records still under another hold are excluded and the second matter is recorded.
generic.Test population: All records released from the closed matter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No released record has had its retention clock reset to the release date.
generic.Exception handling path: Records already past disposition date go straight to the disposition review queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Automated disposition re-enabled and the original retention expiry preserved.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText retention metadata and the restoration event log in the DMS.

steps.title: Confirm no other active hold applies before re-enabling disposition
sop: Check each released record against all other open matters on the register.
Exclude records still held under a second matter.
Record the second matter reference against every excluded record.
Done when the restoration set is free of other active holds.
verify: Cross-check the restoration set against the open hold register.
Pass when no record in the set is held under another matter.

steps.title: Recalculate the retention clock from the original trigger date
sop: Read the original retention trigger date on each record.
Recompute the retention expiry from that date plus the retention period.
Never restart the clock from the hold release date.
Done when every record carries its original-basis expiry.
verify: Compare recomputed expiries to the pre-hold expiry values.
Pass when every expiry matches the original-basis calculation.

steps.title: Re-enable automated disposition on the released records
sop: Clear the disposition suspension flag in OpenText for the released set.
Confirm the disposition job now evaluates those records.
Escalate any record where suspension cannot be cleared.
Done when disposition is re-enabled across the released set.
verify: Run the disposition eligibility check across the released set.
Pass when the check evaluates every released record.

steps.title: Route records already past disposition date to the review queue
sop: Identify released records whose expiry passed while they were held.
Route them straight into the disposition review queue.
Record the over-retention duration for reporting.
Done when all such records are in the review queue.
verify: Compare the past-expiry population to the review queue contents.
Pass when every past-expiry record appears in the queue.

steps.title: Clear read-only and quarantine flags to restore access
sop: Clear quarantine and read-only flags on the released records.
Confirm business users regain normal access in the repository.
Escalate any record where access is not restored.
Done when normal access is restored across the released set.
verify: Open and edit a sample of released records as a business user.
Pass when normal access works on every sampled record.

steps.title: Log the restoration event against each record
sop: Write a restoration event on each released record in OpenText.
Record the releasing matter reference and the restoration timestamp.
Retain the event for the audit trail.
Done when every released record carries a restoration event.
verify: Query released records with no restoration event.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-scope staff including contractors and offshore BPO staff handling records.
generic.In-scope period: Current training cycle plus refreshers triggered by process or schedule changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Staff name, role module, completion date, knowledge check score and pass or fail.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Completion records reconcile to the current staff roster including contractors.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completion records retained with course version and completion timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failures are logged with the re-take date and the eventual pass recorded.
generic.Test population: All in-scope staff on the roster for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-scope staff member is past due on the retention training cycle.
generic.Exception handling path: Knowledge check failures require a re-take before completion is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Role-specific modules delivered for intake, correspondence and records-admin staff.
generic.Evidence location: Training completion records in SharePoint and the course material in the DMS.

steps.title: Build role-specific modules for intake, correspondence and records admin
sop: Split the training into modules for intake, correspondence and records-admin roles.
Cover the retention schedule, classification at intake and legal holds in each.
State the ban on ad-hoc deletion explicitly in every module.
Done when each role has its own module covering all four topics.
verify: Read each module against the four required topics.
Pass when every module covers all four topics.

steps.title: Build the roster of in-scope staff including contractors and BPO
sop: Extract the current staff roster for intake, correspondence and records roles.
Add contractors and offshore BPO staff performing in-scope work.
Publish the roster as the completion tracking population.
Done when the roster covers all in-scope staff.
verify: Compare the roster to the access list for the document repository.
Pass when every repository user in scope appears on the roster.

steps.title: Deliver the training through the SharePoint learning workspace
sop: Publish the modules to the SharePoint learning workspace.
Assign each staff member the module matching their role.
Set the completion deadline for the cycle.
Done when every roster member has an assigned module and deadline.
verify: Read assignments against the roster.
Pass when every roster member has an assignment.

steps.title: Administer the knowledge check with a pass mark
sop: Administer the knowledge check at the end of each module.
Apply the published pass mark to the result.
Require a re-take where the pass mark is not met.
Done when every attendee has a recorded knowledge check result.
verify: Read results for attendees with no recorded score.
Pass when every attendee has a recorded score at or above the pass mark.

steps.title: Track completion against the roster and chase overdue staff
sop: Compare completions to the roster during the cycle.
Chase staff approaching the completion deadline.
Escalate to line managers where staff pass the deadline.
Done when every roster member is complete or escalated.
verify: Read the completion tracker at cycle end.
Pass when no in-scope staff member is past due.

steps.title: Trigger refreshers when the schedule or classification process changes
sop: Monitor for retention schedule and DMS classification process changes.
Update the affected module and issue a refresher assignment.
Record the course version against the refresher completions.
Done when every material change triggers a refresher.
verify: Compare material changes in the period to refresher assignments.
Pass when every material change has a matching refresher.

generic.Defined scope/population: All records whose retention period has expired based on trigger date plus retention period.
generic.In-scope period: Current disposition job run and the records-owner review window that follows.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention trigger date, retention period, eligibility result and record class grouping.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disposition list counts by record class reconcile to the eligibility query output.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disposition job log with run date, criteria version and eligible record counts.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records failing eligibility for a data-quality reason are reported for fix, not skipped.
generic.Test population: All records evaluated by the disposition job.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No record under legal hold or with an open claim appears in the review queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Held, open-claim, open-litigation and open-complaint records are filtered out of eligibility.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Records-owner review requested with a response deadline so lists do not sit unactioned.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText disposition job log and the disposition review queue in the DMS.

steps.title: Run the scheduled disposition eligibility job in OpenText
sop: Run the disposition job on its published schedule.
Recalculate eligibility from retention trigger date plus retention period.
Record the run date and criteria version on the job log.
Done when the job completes across the repository.
verify: Compare records evaluated to the repository record count.
Pass when the job evaluated the whole repository.

steps.title: Apply hold, claim, litigation and complaint exclusion filters
sop: Filter out records under legal hold from the eligible population.
Filter out records with an open claim, litigation or complaint.
Record the excluded counts by exclusion reason.
Done when all exclusion filters are applied.
verify: Cross-check the eligible list against the open hold register and claim status.
Pass when no held or open-claim record appears as eligible.

steps.title: Group eligible records into a disposition list by record class
sop: Group eligible records by record class with counts and date ranges.
Present the grouping in the format the approver requires.
Confirm the group counts sum to the eligible population.
Done when the disposition list is grouped and reconciled.
verify: Sum the group counts against the eligible population.
Pass when the group counts sum to the eligible total.

steps.title: Request records-owner review with a response deadline
sop: Send the grouped list to the records owner for review.
Set a response deadline on the review request.
Chase where the deadline passes without a response.
Done when the review request is issued with a deadline.
verify: Read the review request for a stated deadline.
Pass when the request carries a response deadline.

steps.title: Report records failing eligibility for data-quality reasons
sop: List records skipped because the trigger date is missing or invalid.
Report them as a data-quality exception with an owner.
Do not allow them to be silently skipped each run.
Done when every data-quality skip is reported with an owner.
verify: Read the data-quality exception report against the skipped population.
Pass when every skipped record appears with an owner.

steps.title: Load the reviewed list into the disposition review queue
sop: Load the reviewed and filtered list into the disposition review queue in the DMS.
Confirm the queue contents match the reviewed list.
Hand the queue to the disposition approval process.
Done when the queue is loaded and handed over.
verify: Compare queue contents to the reviewed list and the hold register.
Pass when the queue matches the list and contains no held record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every document type routed for electronic delivery in each state written.
generic.In-scope period: Current routing cycle plus any state statute changes since the last matrix review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type, risk state, eligibility result and the driving state rule reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Eligibility decisions issued equal electronic routing candidates in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rule outcome logged on the distribution record with the matrix version applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ineligible items are logged with the paper decision and the rule that forced it.
generic.Test population: All distribution records routed in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No state-restricted document type was delivered electronically in that state.
generic.Exception handling path: Hard-blocked types are forced to paper before reaching the electronic channel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Risk state drives the eligibility test where risk and mailing state differ.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin distribution record and the eligibility matrix held with the portal configuration.

steps.title: Load the state-by-document-type eligibility matrix into routing
sop: Confirm the current eligibility matrix version is loaded in the policy admin system.
Check the matrix covers every document type routed electronically.
Record the matrix version on the routing configuration.
Done when the current matrix is loaded and covers all types.
verify: Compare the loaded matrix version to the approved version.
Pass when the loaded version is the approved one.

steps.title: Hard-block paper-only document types from the electronic channel
sop: Identify document types that must be paper in specific states.
Configure a hard block so those combinations cannot route electronically.
Test the block with a sample transaction in each affected state.
Done when every paper-only combination is hard-blocked.
verify: Attempt an electronic route for a blocked combination.
Pass when the routing is refused.

steps.title: Drive the eligibility test from risk state not mailing state
sop: Read the risk state from the policy record for the eligibility test.
Confirm the rule does not read the mailing state where the two differ.
Test a policy where risk and mailing state differ.
Done when the test uses risk state in every case.
verify: Check the eligibility outcome on a differing-state test policy.
Pass when the outcome follows the risk state rule.

steps.title: Log the rule outcome on the distribution record
sop: Write the eligibility decision and the driving rule onto the distribution record.
Include the matrix version applied at decision time.
Ensure the paper decision is auditable after the fact.
Done when every distribution record carries a logged decision.
verify: Query distribution records with no eligibility decision logged.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Re-verify the matrix when a state amends its e-delivery statute
sop: Monitor the regulatory change feed for e-delivery statute amendments.
Re-verify the affected matrix rows against the amended statute.
Update the matrix version and cite the amendment.
Done when every amendment is reflected in the matrix.
verify: Compare amendments in the period to matrix version changes.
Pass when every amendment produced a matrix change.

steps.title: Sample-test electronic deliveries against the restriction list
sop: Extract electronic deliveries made in the period by state and document type.
Compare against the paper-only restriction list.
Escalate any breach for immediate rule correction.
Done when the electronic set is tested against the restrictions.
verify: Search the electronic set for a restricted state and type combination.
Pass when no restricted combination was delivered electronically.

generic.Defined scope/population: The sampled population of e-consent records tested against state e-delivery statutes.
generic.In-scope period: Current audit year covering consents captured and revocations processed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Consent date, disclosure version, capability acknowledgement and revocation date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled consent count reconciles to the consented party population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit report retained with sample basis, results, findings and the issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Findings carry an owner and remediation date and are re-tested at closure.
generic.Test population: The drawn sample of e-consent records for the audit year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No sampled customer received electronic delivery before their consent date.
generic.Exception handling path: Findings are re-tested at closure rather than closed on assertion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sample tested for affirmative consent, capability disclosure, withdrawal right and demonstrated access.
generic.Evidence location: Portal consent records, policy admin delivery history and the audit report in the DMS.

steps.title: Draw the e-consent audit sample from the portal consent register
sop: Extract the consented party population from the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Draw the sample to the sampling standard across states and product lines.
Record the sample basis in the audit workpapers.
Done when the sample is drawn and recorded.
verify: Compare the sample size and spread to the sampling standard.
Pass when the sample meets the standard.

steps.title: Test the four required consent elements on each sampled record
sop: Test for affirmative consent, hardware and software capability disclosure.
Test for the right-to-withdraw disclosure and demonstrated access to the format.
Record a pass or fail per element on each sampled record.
Done when all four elements are tested on every sampled record.
verify: Read the workpapers for sampled records with an untested element.
Pass when every sampled record has all four elements tested.

steps.title: Test that consent date precedes first electronic delivery
sop: Extract the first electronic delivery date per sampled customer from policy admin.
Compare against the stored consent date.
Log any delivery preceding consent as a finding.
Done when the comparison is complete for every sampled customer.
verify: Re-run the date comparison across the sample.
Pass when no sampled customer received delivery before consent.

steps.title: Compare acknowledged disclosure version to the version in force
sop: Read the disclosure version acknowledged on each sampled consent.
Compare against the version in force on the consent date.
Log mismatches as a disclosure version finding.
Done when the version comparison is complete.
verify: Re-check three mismatches against the disclosure version history.
Pass when the logged mismatches are confirmed.

steps.title: Test revocations end to end from date to paper switch
sop: Select revocations in the audit year from the portal consent history.
Confirm the revocation date, the switch to paper and no later electronic sends.
Log any electronic send after the revocation date as a finding.
Done when every sampled revocation is tested end to end.
verify: Query electronic deliveries after each sampled revocation date.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Issue the audit report and re-test findings at closure
sop: Issue the annual audit report with sample, results and findings.
Assign each finding an owner and a remediation date.
Re-test each finding before closing it rather than closing on assertion.
Done when the report is issued and findings are tracked.
verify: Read closed findings for re-test evidence.
Pass when every closed finding carries re-test evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: All customers being offered electronic delivery who have not yet given valid consent.
generic.In-scope period: From consent offer to consent acceptance, before any first electronic delivery.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Consent timestamp, disclosure version, capability acknowledgement and consented contact point.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consent records created equal customers switched to electronic delivery.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consent record stores the acknowledgement event with its timestamp and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Incomplete consent attempts are abandoned and the customer stays on paper.
generic.Test population: All consent records captured in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No consent record exists without a capability disclosure acknowledgement.
generic.Exception handling path: An unreachable email or portal account blocks consent from taking effect.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consent taken by affirmative action with no pre-ticked box and no consent by silence.
generic.Evidence location: Portal consent record, policy admin preference field and the CRM interaction log.

steps.title: Present the capability disclosure before accepting consent
sop: Display the hardware and software capability disclosure in the portal flow.
Require the customer to acknowledge it before the consent step opens.
Record the disclosure version presented.
Done when the disclosure is acknowledged before consent.
verify: Read the consent record for a preceding acknowledgement event.
Pass when the acknowledgement timestamp precedes the consent timestamp.

steps.title: Disclose the right to withdraw on the same screen
sop: Show the right to withdraw, the method to withdraw and any consequences.
Keep the disclosure on the same screen as the consent action.
Version the wording so the acknowledged version is recorded.
Done when the withdrawal disclosure appears with the consent action.
verify: Open the consent screen and read the withdrawal disclosure.
Pass when withdrawal right, method and consequences are all shown.

steps.title: Require an affirmative consent action in the portal
sop: Require the customer to tick the consent box and submit.
Ensure the box is never pre-ticked in the portal configuration.
Never treat silence or inaction as consent.
Done when consent is recorded only on an affirmative action.
verify: Load the consent screen and inspect the default checkbox state.
Pass when the checkbox loads unticked.

steps.title: Test consent by having the customer access a document in the format
sop: Present a test document in the delivery format during the consent flow.
Require the customer to open or acknowledge it.
Record the access event on the consent record.
Done when the format access test is completed and recorded.
verify: Read consent records for a format access event.
Pass when every consent record carries an access event.

steps.title: Verify the email address or portal account is reachable
sop: Send a verification message to the nominated contact point.
Confirm it is delivered and not bounced before consent takes effect.
Hold consent as pending where verification fails.
Done when the contact point is verified reachable.
verify: Query effective consents with an unverified contact point.
Pass when no effective consent has an unverified contact point.

steps.title: Write the consent to the policy admin system and CRM
sop: Write consent timestamp, disclosure version and contact point to the consent record.
Update the delivery preference on the policy record in the policy admin system.
Log the interaction in the CRM against the party.
Done when all three systems reflect the captured consent.
verify: Compare the consent record, policy preference and CRM entry.
Pass when all three agree on consent date and contact point.

generic.Defined scope/population: All e-consent records held at party level across every policy the party holds.
generic.In-scope period: Ongoing maintenance cycle covering consents, revocations and re-consents.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Consent date, capture channel, disclosure version and consented contact point.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Party-level consents map to every policy the party holds in the admin system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each consent, revocation and re-consent held as a new dated row, not an overwrite.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contact point changes requiring re-confirmation are logged with the new consent event.
generic.Test population: All consent records maintained in the repository.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No consent record has been updated in place without a preserved prior version.
generic.Exception handling path: Consent records are retained for the underlying policy retention period, not purged at termination.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consent history shows dated rows for consent, revocation and re-consent events.
generic.Evidence location: Consent history in the DMS, the portal consent register and policy admin preferences.

steps.title: Store consent attributes on the consent record in the DMS
sop: Store consent date, capture channel and disclosure version on the record.
Store the contact point the customer consented to.
Reject any consent record missing one of these attributes.
Done when every consent record holds all four attributes.
verify: Query consent records with a blank attribute.
Pass when no consent record has a blank attribute.

steps.title: Hold every consent change as a new dated row
sop: Configure the consent store so consents, revocations and re-consents append rows.
Prevent in-place updates that overwrite the prior state.
Confirm the prior row remains readable after a change.
Done when consent changes always append a dated row.
verify: Apply a test revocation and read the consent history.
Pass when both the original and the revocation rows are present.

steps.title: Link consent at party level and map to every policy held
sop: Hold the consent against the party rather than a single policy.
Map the party consent to every policy that party holds.
Reconcile the mapping when a new policy is issued to that party.
Done when party consent applies consistently across all their policies.
verify: Compare consent application across all policies held by a sampled party.
Pass when the same consent applies across every policy.

steps.title: Retain consent records for the underlying policy retention period
sop: Set the consent record retention to match the underlying policy retention.
Prevent purge at policy termination where the policy record persists.
Confirm the disposition job honours the longer period.
Done when consent retention matches policy retention.
verify: Run the disposition eligibility check across terminated-policy consents.
Pass when no consent is eligible before its policy retention expires.

steps.title: Create a new consent event on a contact point change
sop: Detect email address or portal identifier changes on consented parties.
Create a new consent event where the state requires re-confirmation.
Hold electronic delivery until the re-confirmation completes.
Done when every re-confirmation state change has a new consent event.
verify: Compare contact point changes to new consent events created.
Pass when every change in a re-confirmation state produced an event.

steps.title: Reconcile consent records across the portal and policy admin system
sop: Extract consent status from the portal and the policy admin preference field.
Compare the two for disagreement on any party.
Correct the disagreement to the consent history as system of record.
Done when the two sources agree for every party.
verify: Re-run the comparison after correction.
Pass when portal and policy admin consent status agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All electronic delivery attempts across email and the customer portal for the period.
generic.In-scope period: Current monitoring period with repeat failures tracked across prior periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Failure type, failure count, affected contact point and downstream fallback action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Failure counts reconcile against paper-fallback counts for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Metrics report stored with the extract date and the period covered.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Repeat-failing addresses are listed for cleansing and possible consent revocation.
generic.Test population: All electronic delivery attempts in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No failed electronic delivery lacks a corresponding fallback or remediation action.
generic.Exception handling path: Domain-level delivery problems are escalated to IT rather than treated as customer failures.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hard bounce, soft bounce, spam-block and mailbox-full reported separately.
generic.Evidence location: Portal delivery logs, policy admin fallback records and the metrics report in the DMS.

steps.title: Extract email failures split by failure type
sop: Extract email delivery failures for the period from the send platform.
Split them into hard bounce, soft bounce, spam-block and mailbox-full.
Reject a single blended bounce figure as the reported number.
Done when failures are split by type.
verify: Sum the split counts against the total failure count.
Pass when the split sums to the total.

steps.title: Track portal access failures distinctly from email failures
sop: Extract login failures, document-not-visible and expired-link events from the portal.
Report them as a separate portal failure category.
Do not merge portal failures into the email bounce figure.
Done when portal failures are reported separately.
verify: Read the report for a merged failure category.
Pass when portal and email failures appear as separate categories.

steps.title: Reconcile failure counts against paper fallback counts
sop: Extract paper fallback distributions raised in the period.
Match each failure to a fallback or remediation action.
Chase failures with no downstream action.
Done when every failure maps to an action.
verify: Recompute the match after chasing.
Pass when no failure lacks a downstream action.

steps.title: List repeat-failing email addresses for contact-data cleansing
sop: Group failures by contact point across the current and prior periods.
List addresses failing more than once for cleansing.
Recommend consent revocation where failures persist.
Done when the repeat-failure list is produced with recommendations.
verify: Check the list entries carry an owner and a recommendation.
Pass when every listed address has an owner and a recommendation.

steps.title: Escalate domain-level delivery problems to IT
sop: Group failures by recipient domain to spot a single ISP blocking.
Raise an IT ticket for domain-level blocking rather than treating it as customer failure.
Track the ticket until delivery to the domain resumes.
Done when every domain-level pattern has an IT ticket.
verify: Match domain-level patterns to raised IT tickets.
Pass when every domain pattern carries a ticket reference.

steps.title: Publish the e-delivery metrics report for the period
sop: Assemble bounce, portal-failure and fallback counts into the report.
Store the report in the document management repository.
Circulate exceptions to their owners for action.
Done when the report is published and exceptions circulated.
verify: Open the stored report and check all three count sections.
Pass when bounce, portal-failure and fallback counts are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All consented electronic documents queued for posting to the customer self-service portal.
generic.In-scope period: Current posting run, from queue pickup to availability confirmation or fallback.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Verified party account, policy id, posting date, category and portal retention period.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal postings completed equal documents queued less suppressed items.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting event stored with the posting date and the format rendered.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Repeat upload failures are escalated to paper fallback with the reason logged.
generic.Test population: All documents in the posting run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No document is posted to a portal account that is not the policyholder's.
generic.Exception handling path: Postings are suppressed where consent is inactive or the type is paper-only in that state.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Document rendered in a format the customer can retain and print per the consent disclosure.
generic.Evidence location: Customer Self-Service Portal posting log and the source document in the DMS.

steps.title: Verify the party account before uploading to the portal
sop: Resolve the portal account from the party id on the distribution record.
Confirm the account is verified and belongs to the policyholder.
Hold postings where the account cannot be verified.
Done when every posting has a verified party account.
verify: Sample resolved accounts against party records in the policy admin system.
Pass when every sampled account is the policyholder's.

steps.title: Suppress postings where consent is inactive or the type is paper-only
sop: Re-read consent status live at posting time for each queued document.
Check the document type against the state paper-only list.
Suppress and route to print where either check fails.
Done when all failing items are suppressed from the run.
verify: Search the posted set for an inactive-consent or paper-only item.
Pass when no such item was posted.

steps.title: Upload the document in a retainable and printable format
sop: Render the document in the format named in the consent disclosure.
Confirm the customer can download, retain and print the file.
Reject formats that cannot be retained by the customer.
Done when every posting uses the disclosed retainable format.
verify: Download and print a sample posting as the customer.
Pass when every sampled document downloads and prints.

steps.title: Set the posting date, category and portal retention period
sop: Set the posting date and document category on the portal entry.
Set the portal retention so the document stays available for the required window.
Correct entries with a default or missing retention period.
Done when every posting carries date, category and retention period.
verify: Read the portal entries for missing category or retention values.
Pass when no entry is missing either value.

steps.title: Confirm the document is visible under the correct policy
sop: Open the account document list and locate the posted document.
Confirm it sits under the intended policy on that account.
Correct any posting attached to the wrong policy.
Done when every posting is visible under the correct policy.
verify: Re-open the sampled account document lists.
Pass when every sampled document sits under the intended policy.

steps.title: Retry failed uploads then escalate to paper fallback
sop: List uploads that failed or were not visible after posting.
Retry the upload once and re-run the visibility check.
Escalate repeat failures to paper fallback rather than leaving them queued.
Done when no failed upload remains without a retry or fallback.
verify: Read the posting failure log for entries with no outcome.
Pass when every failure carries a retry or fallback outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All e-consent revocations received through any channel the customer chose to use.
generic.In-scope period: From revocation receipt to preference change across all policies held by the party.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Revocation date, channel received, effective date and validated mailing address.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies switched to paper equal policies held by the revoking party.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revocation row stored dated on the consent history with the receipt channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-flight electronic distributions stopped or re-routed are logged with the outcome.
generic.Test population: All revocations processed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No electronic delivery is sent to the party after the revocation effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: An invalid mailing address is corrected before the paper switch takes effect.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Revocation accepted through any reasonable method, not only the portal toggle.
generic.Evidence location: Portal consent history, policy admin preference fields and the CRM interaction log.

steps.title: Accept the revocation through whichever channel the customer used
sop: Accept revocations by portal, phone, letter or email.
Record the channel the revocation was received through.
Never require the customer to use the portal toggle only.
Done when the revocation is accepted and its channel recorded.
verify: Read revocation records for a recorded receipt channel.
Pass when every revocation names a receipt channel.

steps.title: Validate the mailing address before switching to paper
sop: Read the mailing address on the policy record for the party.
Validate and standardise it before the paper switch takes effect.
Correct the address with the customer during the same contact.
Done when the mailing address is validated.
verify: Query paper-switched parties with an unvalidated mailing address.
Pass when no such party exists.

steps.title: Flip the delivery preference to paper on every policy the party holds
sop: List every policy held by the revoking party in the policy admin system.
Set the delivery preference to paper on each one.
Do not limit the change to the policy discussed on the call.
Done when all policies held by the party are set to paper.
verify: Compare policies switched to policies held by the party.
Pass when every policy held is switched to paper.

steps.title: Stop or re-route in-flight electronic distributions
sop: Search for queued electronic distributions for the party.
Stop them or re-route to paper before they send.
Log the stop or re-route outcome against the revocation.
Done when no in-flight electronic distribution remains for the party.
verify: Query electronic sends for the party after the revocation date.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Write the dated revocation row to the consent history
sop: Append a dated revocation row to the consent history in the portal.
Record the revocation effective date and receipt channel.
Preserve the prior consent row rather than overwriting it.
Done when the revocation is recorded as a new dated row.
verify: Read the consent history for the party.
Pass when both the prior consent and the revocation rows are present.

steps.title: Send the revocation confirmation stating the effective date
sop: Send the customer a confirmation of the revocation.
State the effective date of the change to paper delivery.
Log the confirmation on the CRM interaction record.
Done when every revocation has a logged confirmation.
verify: Match confirmations sent to revocations processed.
Pass when every revocation has a logged confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Consented parties measured against the defined eligible party population.
generic.In-scope period: Prior calendar month with month-over-month movement commentary.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Adoption rate, eligible population definition, failure rate and paper fallback volume.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consented and eligible counts reconcile to the portal and policy admin extracts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version stored with the extract date and the reporting month.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material movements carry commentary naming the driver and any corrective action.
generic.Test population: All eligible parties in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report shows adoption rate, failure rate and paper fallback volume for the month.
generic.Exception handling path: Adoption growth masking rising failure is flagged for operational action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Adoption split by product line, acquisition channel and state.
generic.Evidence location: Portal consent extract, policy admin distribution extract and the monthly report.

steps.title: Define and extract the eligible party population
sop: State the eligibility rule for the reporting month.
Extract the eligible party population from the policy admin system.
Record the definition alongside the count in the report.
Done when the eligible population is extracted and defined.
verify: Re-apply the eligibility rule to the party base.
Pass when the re-derived count matches the extracted count.

steps.title: Compute adoption as consented over eligible parties
sop: Extract consented party count from the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Divide by the eligible party population to give the adoption rate.
Show both the numerator and denominator in the report.
Done when the adoption rate is computed and shown with its basis.
verify: Recompute the ratio from the numerator and denominator.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported rate.

steps.title: Split adoption by product line, acquisition channel and state
sop: Break the adoption rate down by product line, acquisition channel and state.
Highlight segments where consent capture is materially weak.
Recommend a capture action for each weak segment.
Done when the three-way split and recommendations are complete.
verify: Sum the segment populations against the eligible total.
Pass when the segments sum to the eligible population.

steps.title: Report paper fallback volume with its cost impact
sop: Extract paper fallback distributions for the month.
Apply the standard postage and print cost to give the cost impact.
Show the postage saving implied by current adoption.
Done when fallback volume and cost impact are reported.
verify: Recompute the cost from the fallback volume and unit cost.
Pass when the recomputed cost matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Trend failure rate alongside adoption
sop: Place the electronic failure rate beside the adoption rate in the trend.
Flag where adoption growth is accompanied by rising failure.
Raise the flag for operational action rather than reporting adoption alone.
Done when both series are trended and flags raised.
verify: Read the trend for periods where both series rose.
Pass when every such period carries a raised flag.

steps.title: Write movement commentary and deliver the monthly report
sop: Write commentary naming the drivers of material month-over-month movement.
Assemble adoption, failure and fallback sections into the report.
Deliver it to operations management on the monthly cadence.
Done when the report is delivered with commentary.
verify: Read the report for material movements with no commentary.
Pass when every material movement carries commentary.

generic.Defined scope/population: All customer inquiries about document delivery status or consent preference in the period.
generic.In-scope period: Current service day, from inquiry receipt to logged resolution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authentication outcome, inquiry topic, delivery history checked and resolution outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged interactions equal inquiries received across phone, email and portal.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: CRM interaction stores the outcome and the resolution timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolved inquiries are escalated with an owner and a follow-up date.
generic.Test population: All delivery inquiries handled in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No delivery inquiry is closed without a recorded outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Address or email corrections are made in the system of record during the same contact.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Caller authenticated before any delivery detail or document is disclosed.
generic.Evidence location: CRM interaction log, policy admin delivery history and the document record in the DMS.

steps.title: Authenticate the caller against the policy record
sop: Open the policy record in the policy admin system.
Verify the caller against the authentication standard.
Disclose no delivery detail or document until authentication passes.
Done when the caller is authenticated or the call is refused.
verify: Read the CRM interaction for a recorded authentication outcome.
