Pass when every interaction records an authentication outcome.

steps.title: Check delivery history before promising a re-send
sop: Read the delivery history on the policy record for date, channel and recipient.
Read the delivery confirmation status on the document.
Explain the position to the customer before offering a re-send.
Done when delivery history has been checked and explained.
verify: Read interactions offering a re-send for a preceding history check.
Pass when every re-send offer follows a history check.

steps.title: Correct the address or email in the system of record on the call
sop: Where delivery failed, explain the undeliverable status to the customer.
Correct the address or email in the policy admin system during the same contact.
Validate the corrected value before ending the contact.
Done when the contact data is corrected and validated.
verify: Compare corrected records to the values captured on the call.
Pass when every correction is present and validated in the system.

steps.title: Explain consent status and change the preference if requested
sop: Read the consent status where the customer expected paper but is on e-delivery.
Explain the consent on file and its effective date.
Change the delivery preference where the customer asks.
Done when consent is explained and any requested change is made.
verify: Compare requested preference changes to changes made in the system.
Pass when every requested change is applied.

steps.title: Raise the re-send or reissue where the customer needs the document
sop: Retrieve the archived document from the DMS for a re-send.
Release it on the channel confirmed with the customer.
Record the re-send reference on the CRM interaction.
Done when the re-send is released and referenced.
verify: Match re-send references to interactions promising a re-send.
Pass when every promised re-send has a reference.

steps.title: Log the interaction outcome against the policy in the CRM
sop: Log the inquiry, actions taken and outcome against the policy in the CRM.
Record any preference change or re-send made.
Close the interaction only once the outcome is recorded.
Done when the interaction is logged and closed with an outcome.
verify: Query closed delivery inquiries with no recorded outcome.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: All portal postings confirmed available that require a customer delivery notification.
generic.In-scope period: Current notification run, from posting confirmation to send event capture.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document id, recipient contact point, notification timestamp and posting reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notifications sent equal portal postings confirmed available in the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification send event recorded against the document with recipient and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notification bounces are treated as delivery failures with a logged fallback.
generic.Test population: All notifications issued in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No notification is sent before the corresponding document is available.
generic.Exception handling path: Bounced notifications trigger the delivery fallback path, not just a resend attempt.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification identifies document type and retrieval location without embedding PII.
generic.Evidence location: Portal notification log, policy admin delivery history and the CRM contact record.

steps.title: Confirm portal availability before firing the notification
sop: Read the posting confirmation status for each queued notification.
Hold notifications where the document is not yet confirmed available.
Release only notifications whose document is retrievable.
Done when every released notification has a confirmed posting.
verify: Compare notification timestamps to posting confirmation timestamps.
Pass when every notification follows its posting confirmation.

steps.title: Send to the consented contact point on file
sop: Read the consented contact point from the consent record.
Send the notification to that contact point only.
Do not use a newer unverified address held elsewhere.
Done when every notification targets the consented contact point.
verify: Compare notification recipients to the consented contact points.
Pass when every recipient matches the consented contact point.

steps.title: Compose the notification without PII or the document itself
sop: Name the document type and where to retrieve it in the notification body.
Do not embed PII or attach the document.
Use the approved notification template in the portal.
Done when the notification body is compliant and informative.
verify: Read the sent notification bodies for PII or attachments.
Pass when no notification contains PII or an attachment.

steps.title: Record the notification send event against the document
sop: Write the send event against the document with recipient and timestamp.
Treat the event as part of the delivery evidence chain.
Flag documents posted with no notification event.
Done when every notification has a recorded send event.
verify: Query posted documents with no notification send event.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Treat notification bounces as delivery failures
sop: Capture bounce events on the notification send.
Record them as electronic delivery failures against the document.
Trigger the fallback path rather than a silent resend.
Done when every bounce is recorded and routed to fallback.
verify: Read the bounce list for entries with no fallback action.
Pass when every bounce carries a fallback action.

steps.title: Reconcile notifications sent to postings confirmed
sop: Extract confirmed postings and notifications sent for the run.
Compare the two counts and list any gap.
Issue missing notifications and log the cause of the gap.
Done when notifications and confirmed postings reconcile.
verify: Re-run the comparison after issuing missing notifications.
Pass when the two counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All hard-bounced or confirmed non-accessed electronic deliveries requiring paper fallback.
generic.In-scope period: From the failed electronic attempt to release of the paper distribution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Failed document id, failure reason, fallback trigger date and validated mailing address.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Paper fallback distributions equal electronic failures requiring fallback.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fallback event and trigger reason recorded in policy history with the date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Repeat failures switch the party preference back to paper with the change logged.
generic.Test population: All failed electronic deliveries in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No failed electronic delivery is left with no paper fallback beyond the required window.
generic.Exception handling path: An invalid mailing address is corrected before the paper job is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The same rendered version is re-sent on paper, not a re-composed current one.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin fallback record, the archived rendering in the DMS and the portal failure log.

steps.title: Identify hard bounces and confirmed non-access events
sop: Extract hard bounces from the send platform and non-access events from the portal.
Exclude soft bounces still inside their retry window.
List each failure with its failure date and document id.
Done when the fallback candidate list is produced.
verify: Compare the candidate list to the electronic failure log.
Pass when every qualifying failure appears on the list.

steps.title: Validate and correct the mailing address before release
sop: Read the mailing address on the policy record for each fallback candidate.
Validate and standardise it before the paper job is released.
Hold candidates whose address cannot be validated.
Done when every released fallback has a validated address.
verify: Query released fallbacks with an unvalidated address.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Retrieve the original rendering from the DMS for re-sending
sop: Retrieve the archived rendered document that failed electronic delivery.
Use that exact version for the paper job.
Do not re-compose the document from current policy data.
Done when the archived rendering is queued for print.
verify: Compare the printed version render id to the failed delivery render id.
Pass when the render ids match.

steps.title: Release the paper job within the required timeframe
sop: Compute the fallback deadline from the failed attempt date.
Release the paper distribution inside that timeframe.
Escalate any candidate approaching the deadline unreleased.
Done when every fallback is released inside its timeframe.
verify: Compare release dates to the computed fallback deadlines.
Pass when every release precedes its deadline.

steps.title: Switch repeat failures back to paper preference
sop: Identify parties failing electronic delivery repeatedly across cycles.
Set the delivery preference back to paper for those parties.
Log the preference change with the failure history as its basis.
Done when every repeat failer is switched to paper.
verify: Query repeat failers still set to electronic delivery.
Pass when no repeat failer remains on electronic delivery.

steps.title: Record the fallback event and reason in policy history
sop: Write the fallback event into policy history in the policy admin system.
Record the trigger reason such as hard bounce or portal non-access.
Retain the entry as evidence the delivery obligation was met.
Done when every fallback has a policy history event with its reason.
verify: Query released fallbacks with no policy history event.
Pass when no released fallback is missing its event.

generic.Defined scope/population: E-delivery statute and bulletin changes in every state the business writes.
generic.In-scope period: Current change cycle, measured against each change's regulatory effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change reference, state, impacted artefact, decision on existing consents and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Implemented changes equal effective e-delivery changes identified in the feed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change log entry links the regulatory change to the implemented process update.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes that cannot be implemented by the effective date are escalated with a plan.
generic.Test population: All e-delivery regulatory changes identified in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No effective regulatory change remains unimplemented past its effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Where existing consents are invalidated a re-consent campaign is scheduled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Impact assessed against consent screens, disclosure text, eligibility matrix and retention rules.
generic.Evidence location: Change log in SharePoint plus the updated portal screens and policy admin rules.

steps.title: Review the regulatory change feed for every state written
sop: Review the change feed for e-delivery statute and bulletin changes.
Cover every state the business writes rather than the largest few.
Log each relevant change with its citation and effective date.
Done when all relevant feed items are logged.
verify: Compare logged items to the feed output for the period.
Pass when every e-delivery item in the feed is logged.

steps.title: Assess impact on screens, disclosures, eligibility and retention
sop: Assess each change against the consent screens and disclosure text.
Assess it against the eligibility matrix and the consent retention rules.
Record the impacted artefacts on the change log entry.
Done when every change has a recorded impact assessment.
verify: Read the change log for entries with no impact assessment.
Pass when every entry carries an assessment across all four artefacts.

steps.title: Update and version the disclosure wording in the portal
sop: Update the disclosure text in the Customer Self-Service Portal.
Increment the disclosure version so new consents record the new version.
Retain the prior version for consents captured under it.
Done when the new disclosure version is live and the old one retained.
verify: Capture a test consent and read the recorded disclosure version.
Pass when the test consent records the new version.

steps.title: Decide whether existing consents remain valid or need re-consent
sop: Assess whether the change invalidates consents already captured.
Record the decision on the change log entry with its rationale.
Schedule a re-consent campaign where existing consents are invalidated.
Done when the validity decision is recorded for every change.
verify: Read the change log for entries with no validity decision.
Pass when every entry records a validity decision.

steps.title: Update SOPs, training material and the eligibility matrix
sop: Update the SOPs and training material affected by the change.
Update the eligibility matrix rows for the affected states.
Release the updates in SharePoint by the regulatory effective date.
Done when all affected artefacts are updated and released.
verify: Compare artefact release dates to the regulatory effective dates.
Pass when every artefact was released by its effective date.

steps.title: Close the change log entry linking change to implementation
sop: Link the regulatory change to the implemented process update on the log.
Confirm every impacted artefact shows an implementation reference.
Escalate any change unimplemented at its effective date.
Done when every change entry is closed or escalated.
verify: Read the change log for effective changes still open.
Pass when no effective change remains unimplemented.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every document being considered for the electronic channel at the point of routing.
generic.In-scope period: Current routing run, from channel evaluation to channel commit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Consent status, consent scope, state eligibility result and contact point status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validation results issued equal documents evaluated for electronic routing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Distribution record stores the consent validation result and its timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Validation failures default the item to paper with the failing check recorded.
generic.Test population: All documents evaluated for electronic routing in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No document routed to e-delivery with an inactive, revoked or out-of-scope consent.
generic.Exception handling path: A previously hard-bounced contact point blocks the electronic route.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consent re-read live at routing rather than taken from a cached preference flag.
generic.Evidence location: Policy admin distribution record, the portal consent register and the DMS document record.

steps.title: Re-read consent live from the portal at the point of routing
sop: Call the portal consent register live for each routing candidate.
Do not rely on a cached preference flag on the policy record.
Record the live read timestamp on the distribution record.
Done when consent is read live for every candidate.
verify: Compare the consent read timestamp to the routing timestamp.
Pass when the consent read occurred at routing time.

steps.title: Check the consent covers this document class
sop: Read the document class scope stored on the consent record.
Confirm the document being routed falls inside that scope.
Fail the validation where the class is outside the consent scope.
Done when class scope is checked for every candidate.
verify: Query electronic routings for an out-of-scope document class.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Apply the state eligibility test on top of the consent check
sop: Run the state e-delivery eligibility test for the document type and risk state.
Require both consent and eligibility to pass before confirming electronic routing.
Record both results on the distribution record.
Done when both checks are applied to every candidate.
verify: Read distribution records for a missing eligibility result.
Pass when every record carries both check results.

steps.title: Confirm the consented contact point is active and not hard-bounced
sop: Read the consented email address or portal account status.
Check it against the hard-bounce and inactive account lists.
Fail the validation where the contact point is unusable.
Done when contact point status is checked for every candidate.
verify: Query electronic routings against a hard-bounced contact point.
Pass when that query returns no rows.

steps.title: Default failed validations to paper rather than assuming
sop: Set the channel to paper for any candidate failing a validation check.
Record which check failed on the distribution record.
Never route electronically on an assumption of consent.
Done when every failed validation results in a paper route.
verify: Compare failed validations to the channel committed.
Pass when every failed validation was routed to paper.

steps.title: Commit the validation result on the distribution record
sop: Write the consolidated validation result onto the distribution record.
Commit the channel only after the result is written.
Retain the result as evidence for the e-consent audit.
Done when every distribution record shows a committed validation result.
verify: Query distribution records with a committed channel but no validation result.
Pass when that query returns no rows.
